raceinfo_chi.RaceName: 中銀香港跨境服務讓賽

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (5W2W2W) On-pace throughout, retreated quickly at 200M mark and eased down thereafter (See Incident Report).
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(5W2W2W) 沿途跟隨領放馬。二百米處迅速墮退。其後收慢。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W1W1W) Bumped start, sent forward to take the lead, led by 1/4L turning in, peaked and headed 200M, weakened final 150M, eased final 75M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W1W1W) 起步時發生碰撞，受催策上前領放。入直路時領先四分一個馬位。二百米處未能再增速及被超越。最後一百五十米轉弱。最後七十五米收慢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W) Sat near the rear 3 wide, never a threat.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W) 居接近後列位置，走第三疊。從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W3W) Sat towards the rear, never in contention.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W3W) 居後列。從未有力一爭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W) Jumped awkwardly, settled midfield, one pace to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W) 出閘笨拙，居中間位置。末段保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Made contact at start, sent forward to take the lead, led by 1/4L turning in, kept on well early in straight, peaked and headed approaching 200M, weakened thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 起步時發生觸碰，受催策上前領放。入直路時領先四分一個馬位。直路早段保持佳勢。趨近二百米處時未能再增速，被超越。其後轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; Began only fairly, positioned a length behind the leader, 2 away from the stands' rail, peaked 350M, weakened thereafter. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;出閘僅屬一般。落後領放馬一個馬位，走外欄第三疊。三百五十米處未能再增速，其後轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (1W1W) Jumped only fairly, sat rear, made good ground when asked inside 200M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(1W1W) 出閘僅屬一般，居後列。最後二百米在催策下追前甚多。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W5W) Held up last, raced wide throughout, pushed along widest into home straight, stayed on but never going pace to challenge leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W5W) 留居包尾位置，沿途走外疊。入直路時受推策，走最外疊。保持走勢，但從未能加速以挑戰領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Settled midfield, traveled reasonably well, closed off okay.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 居中間位置。走勢不俗。末段衝刺尚可。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W4W) Caught 3 wide midfield, nothing extra. (See Incident Report)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W4W) 居中間位置，走第三疊。再無餘力。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W5W) Settled well back from the widest draw and waited with, became last 900M out rounding home bend, shifted wider into straight, ran on under pressure down the centre of the track without threatening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W5W) 自大外檔出閘後遙居後列，留力候上。九百米處轉直路彎時居包尾位置。入直路時移出較外疊。末段沿跑道中央在催策下追前，但未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W3W) Taken back to race at rear on the inside, travelled keenly in the middle stages, 2 wide on very wide into straight, made good progress in straight without threatening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W3W) 留居後列，走內疊。中段搶口，走第二疊。入直路時走大外疊。直路上追前頗多，但未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W3W) Began only fairly from a wide draw, raced 2 wide towards rear, angled out 450M, unable to obtain clear run early in straight, hampered near 200M, made minor progress final 100M. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W3W) 自外檔出閘僅屬一般，居後列，走第二疊。四百五十米處向外移出。直路初未能望空。接近二百米處時受阻礙。最後一百米略為追前。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W1W1W) Jumped well, ridden along to lead, slightly weakened at the top of the Straight, ran on fairly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W1W1W) 出閘迅速，在催策下領放。直路初略為轉弱。走勢一般。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (7W2W2W) Jumped well from the widest draw, raced slightly better than midfield on the outside, moved a bit closer after entering the back straight,2nd in the middle stages, showed limited response early in straight, weakened final 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(7W2W2W) 自最外檔出閘迅速，居中間稍前位置，走外疊。入對面直路後略為追近。中段居第二位。直路初對催策反應平平。最後一百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (3W2W2W) Pressed forward from a wide barrier to join race leader early in back straight, commenced move home bend and hit the front from tiring leader upon straightening, unable to sustain effort and swamped inside final 120M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(3W2W2W) 自外檔出閘，受催策上前，在對面直路早段追上領放馬。直路彎開始上前。入直路時超越漸呈疲態的領放馬，取得領先。其後無以為繼，最後一百二十米被後上馬匹超越。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W) Sent forward to lead, weakened from the 300M. (See Incident Report)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W) 受催策上前領放。自三百米處起轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W2W) Recovered quickly from moderate start to lead after the first 100M setting a sound pace, ceded advantage for 2nd spot onto home bend, remained prominent in 3rd into straight but folded up quickly inside final 200M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W2W) 出閘普通，迅速恢復走勢，過了首一百米後取得領先，以快步速領放。開始轉直路彎時被超越，居第二位。入直路時居前列第三位，但最後二百米迅速力竭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Showed good speed to lead, kicked two lengths clear 200m out, in control final 100m, cosy winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 展現甚快前速以領放。二百米處加速帶離兩個馬位。最後一百米控制大局。從容取勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Pressed leader, quickened early to lead top of home straight, stayed on well, pressed by runner-up to line and just prevailed.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 追迫領放馬。直路初加速，取得領先，保持佳勢。被亞軍馬匹追迫至終點，僅勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Under pressure to race in touch with leaders, travelled smoothly into home straight, ran on well final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 受催策以緊隨領先馬匹。入直路時走勢暢順。最後二百米以佳勢上前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W2W) Led, headed halfway, remained prominent, no extra final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W2W) 領放。半程時被超越。保持居前列。最後二百米再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W2W) Away with them, positioned a length behind the leader, 2 wide, there to turn, kept on well early in straight, peaked 150M, ran on evenly to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W2W) 與對手同步躍出，落後領放馬一個馬位，走第二疊。直路彎前居相同位置。直路初保持佳勢。一百五十米處未能再增速。保持穩勢至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W3W) Taken back from a wide draw, raced at rear, 6 to 7 lengths back turning in, made good progress in straight to be nearest on line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W3W) 自外檔出閘後留居後列。入直路時落後六至七個馬位。直路上追前頗多，過終點時最為接近。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W3W) Settled well back from the widest barrier, ran on steadily down the centre of the track inside final 300M to reach 4th late.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W3W) 自最外檔出閘，遙居於後。最後三百米在跑道中央以穩勢上前，末段取得第四名。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W2W) Mid-field, tight for room briefly 250m out, stayed on at the one pace.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W2W) 居中間位置。二百五十米處一度受緊迫。末段保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W) Tracked leaders, driven along 550m out, unable to improve position.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W) 跟隨領先馬匹。五百五十米處受催策，未能推進上前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W2W) Bumped shortly after start, taken back to race at rear on the outside, 6 lengths back turning in, no clear run early in straight, one-paced thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W2W) 起步後不久發生碰撞，留居後列，走外疊。入直路時落後六個馬位。直路早段未能望空，其後保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W2W) Sat worse than midfield, held up between 350M to 300M, closed off fairly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W2W) 居中間之後位置。三百五十米處至三百米處之間受困。衝刺一般。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W4W) Soon taken well back from the widest barrier, wide into straight, found nothing under pressure.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W4W) 自大外檔出閘後瞬即遙居於後。入直路時走外疊。末段在催策下再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W2W) Bumped out of stalls, raced in rear, driven along 500m out, switched for clear run 200m out, lacked pace.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W2W) 出閘時被碰撞，居後列。五百米處受催策。二百米處轉移跑線以望空，但缺乏速度。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W) Settled handy, gave ground rounding the Turn, never a threat.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W) 居前列。轉直路彎時墮退。從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W4W) Sat midfield 3 wide, gave ground in the Straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W4W) 居中間位置，走第三疊。直路上墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W1W) In touch with leaders, pushed along 300m out, one paced.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W1W) 跟隨領先馬匹。三百米處受推策，保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W) Crowded at start, rail position in mid-field, had to wait for run turning into home straight, checked 200m out, lost all chance.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W) 起步時受擠迫，居中間位置，走內欄。轉入直路時須等待空位出現。二百米處勒避，再無爭勝機會。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W2W) Mid-field, hampered when looking to make headway 200m out, never a threat after.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W2W) 居中間位置。二百米處在嘗試上前之際受阻礙。其後從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (3W4W3W) Sat midfield, raced wide throughout, weakened late.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(3W4W3W) 居中間位置，沿途走外疊，末段轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W3W3W) Waited with in rear from high draw, stayed on down the outside final 150m, unable to reach leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W3W3W) 自大外檔出閘後居後列，留力候上。最後一百五十米沿外疊保持走勢，未能追及領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (4W2W2W) Dropped out from widest draw, still in rear top of home straight, never involved.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(4W2W2W) 自最外檔出閘後墮後。直路初仍居後列。從未參與競逐。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W1W3W) Sat at the rear on the rail, picked off a few weakened rivals.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W1W3W) 居後列，走內欄。末段超越數匹已轉弱的對手。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W) Settled on the rail just off the speed, threw his head about in the middle stages, lacked a finish effort over the final stages.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W) 居領放馬稍後位置，走內欄。中段搶口。末段衝刺乏力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Jumped only fairly, sat on pace, gave ground and faded (See Incident Report).
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 出閘僅屬一般，居前列。末段墮退及力竭。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good to fast; (2W3W) Keen mid-race, settled back into mid-field, under pressure 400m out, weakened.
Substantial blood in trachea.
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等偏快步速;(2W3W) 中段搶口，居中間位置。四百米處受催策。轉弱。
氣管內有很多血。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Settle at the rear, picked off a few weakened rivals.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 居後列。末段超越數匹已轉弱的對手。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W3W) Soon picked up to midfield after moderate start, kept on same pace without quickening in home straight, looked beaten when steadied 150M out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W3W) 出閘普通後瞬即加速，居中間位置。直路上保持同速，未能加速。一百五十米處在收慢之際看似洩氣。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W) Crowded after sluggish start, raced in rear, headway through field from over 200m out, stayed on, unable to reach leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W) 出閘緩慢，其後受擠迫，居後列。自二百米處起在馬群中穿插上前。保持走勢。未能追上領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W) Taken back from a wide draw, raced towards rear on the outside, 6 to 7 lengths back turning in, made no impression in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W) 自外檔出閘後留居後列，走外疊。入直路時落後六至七個馬位。直路上毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good to fast; (1W1W1W) Slightly slow out and bumped, positioned 3 lengths behind the leader on the inside, saved ground on turn, peaked early in straight, weakened final furlong.
(Blood in trachea.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等偏快步速;(1W1W1W) 出閘稍慢，發生碰撞，落後領放馬三個馬位，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路初未能再增速。最後二百米轉弱。
（氣管有血。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W4W) Jumped only fairly, sat rear, made steady ground from behind.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W4W) 出閘僅屬一般，居後列。末段自後列以穩勢追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Sat midfield on the rail, switched out in the Straight, closed off evenly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 居中間位置，走內欄。直路上向外移出，末段以穩勢衝刺。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W3W) Crossed gingerly from a wide barrier to share 3L 6th 2-wide onto first bend, gained steadily to within 2L of pace over 700M out, unable to make any further impression in the run to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W3W) 自外檔出閘，逐漸切入。開始轉首個彎位時並居第六位，落後三個馬位，走第二疊。穩步上前，七百米處落後領放馬不逾兩個馬位。末段未能進一步追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W) Three wide in rear of mid-field, taken wider 750m out, unable to get on terms with leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W) 居中間之後位置，走第三疊。七百五十米處被帶出更外疊。未能追上領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (5W3W) Settled in front of midfield, raced very wide until 600M, gave ground passing 350M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(5W3W) 居中間之前位置。六百米處前走大外疊。跑過三百五十米處時墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W2W) Began awkwardly and made contact, raced in midfield on the inside, travelled keenly in the middle stages, 2 to 3 lengths back turning in, kept on evenly in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W2W) 出閘笨拙，與對手互相觸碰，居中間位置，走內疊。中段搶口。入直路時落後兩至三個馬位。直路上保持穩勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Moderately away, positioned 2 lengths behind the leader on the middle track, hard ridden from 400M but showed no response, weakened final furlong.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;出閘普通，落後領放馬兩個馬位，在跑道中央競跑。自四百米處起受力策，但毫無反應。最後二百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W2W2W3W) Average to begin, raced 2 wide in midfield, peaked on turn, weakened early in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W2W2W3W) 出閘普通，居中間位置，走第二疊。直路彎未能再增速。直路早段轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W4W) Settled midfield 2 wide, traveled smoothly, made some progress when asked.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W4W) 居中間位置，走第二疊。走勢暢順。在催策下略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W) Taken back to race at rear on the inside, saved ground on turn, made minor progress early in straight, no clear run final 150M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W) 留居後列，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路早段略為追前。最後一百五十米未能望空。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Settled in mid-field, ridden along 600m out, stayed on but never going pace to get competitive.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 居中間位置。六百米處受催策。保持走勢，但從未能加速以爭勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W4W) Settled in last few 3-wide with cover, widest runner turning in for home, ran on steadily under pressure down the centre of the straight, never nearer.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W4W) 居最後數位之內，走第三疊，有遮擋。轉入直路時走最外疊。直路上受催策，在跑道中央以穩勢上前。以末段最為接近。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W3W3W) Mid-division, three wide, pushed along halfway and struggling to hold position, soon weakened.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W3W3W) 居中間位置，走第三疊。半程時受推策，難以保持位置，瞬即轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W3W) Prominent early, caught behind weakening runner from halfway and shuffled back to rear by top of home straight, no impression under pressure.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W3W) 早段居前列。自半程起在轉弱的對手之後受困，直路初前墮居後列。在催策下毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W) Chased the leader, failed to respond when asked, one pace to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W) 追趕領放馬。對催策毫無反應。末段保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Began well, raced 2 wide slightly behind midfield, wider turning in, made some progress early in straight, no extra final 150M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 出閘迅速，居中間稍後位置，走第二疊。入直路時走較外疊。直路早段略為追前。最後一百五十米再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W4W) Began only fairly, raced 2 to 3 wide towards rear of midfield, 6 lengths back turning in, made minor progress in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W4W) 出閘僅屬一般，居中間之後位置，走第二至第三疊。入直路時落後六個馬位。直路上略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Jumped with them, positioned a length behind the leader on the inside, saved ground on turn, kept on well in straight to take 2nd without threatening the winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 與對手同步躍出，落後領放馬一個馬位，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路上保持佳勢，跑獲亞軍，但未能威脅頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W3W) Away with them, raced 2 wide in midfield early, 3 wide on turn, peaked early in straight, weakened thereafter. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W3W) 與對手同步出閘，早段居中間位置，走第二疊。直路彎走第三疊。直路早段未能再增速，其後轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W) Shifted out and bumped leaving stalls, tracked leaders against rail, well placed into home straight, weakened final 100m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W) 出閘時向外斜跑及發生碰撞，跟隨領先馬匹，走內欄。入直路時居好位。最後一百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W1W) Made running, pressed on 400m out, headed 200m out, no extra.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W1W) 帶頭競跑。四百米處受催策。二百米處被超越。再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W4W) Out in line, raced 3 wide with cover behind midfield, angled out after passing 500M, failed to close off in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W4W) 與對手同步出閘，居中間之後位置，走第三疊，有遮擋。跑過五百米處後向外移出。直路上衝刺乏力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W4W1W1W) Taken back from gate 10, raced at rear, travelled keenly in the early stages, saved ground on turn, showed limited response early in straight, weakened thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W4W1W1W) 自第十檔出閘後留居後列。早段搶口。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路早段對催策反應平平，其後轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good to fast; (3W1W) Dropped in from wide draw, some headway final 200m, never dangerous.
(Lost right front plate.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等偏快步速;(3W1W) 自外檔出閘，移入內疊。最後二百米略為追前。從未能構成威脅。
（失去右前蹄的蹄鐵。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (3W4W) Bumped start, raced behind midfield on the outside, difficult to settle throughout, weakened early in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(3W4W) 起步時發生碰撞，居中間之後位置，走外疊。沿途難以穩定走勢。直路早段轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; Was slow away and settled last, failed to keep up with the field throughout, showed limited response when hard ridden final stages.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;出閘緩慢，居包尾位置。沿途未能跟上馬群。末段對力策反應平平。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W3W) Bumped shortly after start, raced 3 wide behind midfield, travelled keenly in the middle stages, no cover on turn, weakened early in straight. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W3W) 起步後不久發生碰撞，居中間之後位置，走第三疊。中段搶口。直路彎沒有遮擋。直路初轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; Bumped on jumping, raced towards rear, 2 away from the stands' rail, 6 lengths or so back at 400M, hard ridden 350M, failed to make any progress, finished last.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;躍出時發生碰撞，居後列，走外欄第三疊。四百米處落後約六個馬位。三百五十米處受力策，但未能追前。包尾而回。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (4W3W) Settled in front of field, raced wide throughout, could not be quickened inside 200M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(4W3W) 居前列，沿途走外疊。最後二百米未能加速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W) Commenced well, raced in 2nd, 2 wide, there to turn, kept on well early in straight, peaked 200M, weakened gradually final 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W) 出閘迅速。居第二位，走第二疊。直路彎前居相同位置。直路早段保持佳勢。二百米處未能再增速。最後一百米逐漸轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W) Sat just behind the leaders 2 wide, kept on without threatening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W) 居領先馬匹稍後位置，走第二疊。末段保持走勢，但未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W1W) Showed good speed to lead, kicked 350m out, headed by winner 150m out, flattened out final 100m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W1W) 展現甚快前速領放。三百五十米處加速。一百五十米處被頭馬超越。最後一百米洩氣。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W4W) Tracked leaders out wide, travelled smoothly to 350m out, ran on well final 200m to close on leader but always held.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W4W) 跟隨領先馬匹，走外疊。三百五十米處前走勢暢順。最後二百米以佳勢上前，追近領放馬，但一直落後。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W2W) Chased leader against rail, switched to challenge leader on bend, ran on well but headed by winner close home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W2W) 追趕領放馬，走內欄。直路彎轉換跑線以挑戰領放馬。以佳勢上前，但接近終點時被頭馬超越。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Began well, raced 2 wide, a length or so back, same position on turn, hard ridden after passing 250M, took the lead 150M, kept on strongly to the line, won by 3 lengths.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 出閘迅速，落後約一個馬位，走第二疊。直路彎居相同位置。跑過二百五十米處後受力策。一百五十米處取得領先。保持勁勢至終點，以三個馬位之先勝出。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W2W) Slightly slow out, raced at rear throughout, never a factor.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W2W) 出閘稍慢，沿途居後列，從未有力一爭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good; (3W4W) Bumped shortly after start, three wide in mid-field, checked and blundered 900m out, wide into home straight, eased off.
(Roarer again and sustained an abrasion to its left front leg.)
runnerrecords.healthissue_eng: (Roarer again and sustained an abrasion to its left front leg.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等步速;(3W4W) 起步後不久發生碰撞，居中間位置，走第三疊。九百米處勒避及失蹄。入直路時走外疊。末段收慢。
（再次患有喘鳴症及左前腿擦傷。）
runnerrecords.healthissue_chi: （再次患有喘鳴症及左前腿擦傷。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W2W3W) Tracked leaders, switched 400m out, stayed on but never going pace to get competitive.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W2W3W) 跟隨領先馬匹。四百米處轉換跑線。保持走勢，但從未能加速以爭勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Settled midfield, traveled okay, made steady progress late.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 居中間位置，走勢尚可。末段穩步上前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W) Moderately away from gate 1, raced better than midfield on the inside, easy run to turn, kept on well in straight to take 2nd, not quite able to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W) 自第一檔出閘普通，居中間之前位置，走內疊。直路彎前走勢輕鬆。直路上保持佳勢，跑獲亞軍，但未能展開真正挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W2W) Tracked leaders, keen early, unable to pick up for pressure from 500m out, gave ground final 300m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W2W) 跟隨領放馬，早段搶口。自五百米處起受催策，但未能增速。最後三百米墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good to fast; (4W3W3W) Settled behind midfield 3 wide, unable to quicken.
(Roarer again.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等偏快步速;(4W3W3W) 居中間之後位置，走第三疊。末段未能加速。
（再次患有喘鳴症。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W1W1W) Made contact shortly after start, taken back to race at tail, 6 lengths or so back, saved ground on turn, kept to inside after straightening and made some progress.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W1W1W) 起步後不久與對手互相觸碰，留居包尾位置，落後約六個馬位。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。入直路後保持走內疊，略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow(-) Waited with towards rear, pushed along 450m out towards centre of course, stayed on well.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速(-)居後列，留力候上。四百五十米處在跑道中央受推策，保持佳勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W1W) Average to begin, sent forward to take the lead, led by 1/2L turning in, headed near 200M, weakened final 100M. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W1W) 出閘普通，受催策上前領放。入直路時領先半個馬位。接近二百米處時被超越，最後一百米轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Jumped with them, raced better than midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, showed limited response early in straight, ran on evenly to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 與對手同步躍出，居中間之前位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路早段對催策反應平平，保持穩勢至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W) Jumped awkwardly, sat rear, limited response when asked, could not be ridden out when racing tight over the concluding stages.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W) 出閘笨拙，居後列。對催策反應平平。末段緊迫競跑時未能被力策。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Slow; (2W2W) Settled in mid-field, keen early, ridden top of home straight, lacked pace to challenge.
(Roarer again.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
慢步速;(2W2W) 居中間位置，早段搶口。直路初受催策。速度不足以展開挑戰。
（再次患有喘鳴症。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Crowded shortly after start, rail position in rear of mid-field, challenged up rail from 350m out, stayed on well.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 起步後不久受擠迫，居中間之後位置，走內欄。自三百五十米處起沿欄展開挑戰。保持佳勢。

raceinfo_chi.RaceName: 中銀香港中小企理財讓賽

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; Led, unable to quicken 400m out, failed to respond.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;取得領先。四百米處未能加速，對催策毫無反應。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Went forward from draw 1 to be vying for the lead, quickly beaten top of straight and weakened to finish last. (No Vet findings.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 自第一檔出閘後上前爭奪領先。直路初迅速洩氣，轉弱，包尾而回。（賽後接受獸醫檢查，並無發現任何明顯異常之處。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W) Sent forward and keen, pressed leader and clear of rest, weakened home straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W) 受催策上前，搶口，追迫領放馬及帶離餘駒。直路上轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Bumped start, raced in midfield on the inside, 4 lengths or so back, saved ground on turn, showed limited response early in straight, weakened final furlong.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 起步時發生碰撞，居中間位置，落後約四個馬位，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路初對催策反應平平。最後二百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Settled well back, produced late impression closing stages.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;遙居於後。末段略為上前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W2W) Bumped out of stalls, tracked leaders, ran green in home straight, flattened out final 200m, eased once well held.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W2W) 出閘時發生碰撞，跟隨領先馬匹。直路上走勢稚嫩。最後二百米洩氣。落後甚遠時隨即收慢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(-) (6W1W1W) Shifted out at start and made contact, sent forward to take the lead, led by 3-1/2L turning in , kept on well in straight but unable to hold off the winner on line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(-)(6W1W1W) 起步時向外斜跑，與對手互相觸碰，受催策上前取得領先。入直路時領先三個半馬位。直路上保持佳勢，但終點線上不敵頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (4W2W2W) Across to press leader, challenged leader from 400m out, dropped away quickly final 150m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(4W2W2W) 切入追迫領放馬。自四百米處起挑戰領放馬。最後一百五十米迅速墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W1W1W) Jumped well, sent forward to take the lead, led by a length turning in, kept on well in straight but unable to hold off the first two final 50M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W1W1W) 出閘迅速，受催策上前領放。入直路時領先一個馬位。直路上保持佳勢，但最後五十米未能抗衡頭兩名馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(-) (4W1W1W) Showed good speed to lead, kicked top of home straight, headed by winner 100m out, stuck to task.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(-)(4W1W1W) 展現甚快前速，取得領先。直路初加速。一百米處被頭馬超越。持續力拼。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W) Raced outside of leader, unable to quicken with that rival 300m out, stuck to task, stayed on closing stages.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W) 居領放馬外側。三百米處未能與領放馬一同加速。末段在力拼下保持走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Made contact at start, raced better than midfield but trapped wide early, sent forward after passing 700M, took the lead 600M, led by 1/2L turning in, kept on well in straight but unable to hold off the first two close home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 起步時發生觸碰，早段居中間之前位置，走外疊。跑過七百米處後受催策上前。六百米處取得領先。入直路時領先半個馬位。直路上保持佳勢，但接近終點時未能抗衡頭兩名馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (4W3W3W) Bumped start, raced in midfield on the outside, there to turn, finished off evenly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(4W3W3W) 起步時發生碰撞，居中間位置，走外疊。直路彎前居相同位置。末段以穩勢衝刺。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W) Shifted out shortly after start, raced 3 wide with cover towards rear, 5 lengths or so back turning in, made good progress in straight without threatening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W) 起步後不久向外斜跑，居後列，走第三疊，有遮擋。入直路時落後約五個馬位。直路上追前甚多，但未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W3W) Began from the widest barrier settling wide without cover in rear of midfield, slightly worse towards rear rounding home bend and into straight, kept on steadily down the centre of the track.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W3W) 自大外檔出閘，居中間之後位置，走外疊，沒有遮擋。轉直路彎及入直路時略為墮後，居後列。末段保持穩勢，在跑道中央競跑。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Raced on outside of field from low draw, good headway from 300m out despite edging left, led 50m out, cosy winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;自第一檔出閘，居馬群外側競跑。自三百米處起儘管外閃，但追前甚多。五十米處取得領先，輕鬆取勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Chased leader, pushed along 400m out, weakened final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;追趕領放馬。四百米處受推策。最後二百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Ridden hard to lead, weakened notably inside 300M, failed to respond.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 在力策下取得領先。最後三百米顯著轉弱。對催策毫無反應。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (4W3W) Ridden along from a poor draw to be up with the pace 5-wide, closer to rail 3-wide rounding home bend and shared 2nd into straight, unable to sustain effort inside final 300M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(4W3W) 自外檔出閘，受催策，跟隨領放馬，走第五疊。轉直路彎時移近內欄，走第三疊。入直路時並居第二位。最後三百米無以為繼。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Chased leader, tight for room against rail and had to switch 200m out, stayed on at the one pace after.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 追趕領放馬。沿欄受緊迫，二百米處須轉換跑線，其後保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (5W2W2W) Sat outside the leader, failed to quicken in the straight (See Incident Report).
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(5W2W2W) 居領放馬外側。直路上未能加速。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W) Out with rest, taken back to race behind midfield on the outside, very wide turning in, made some headway in straight to make frame.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W) 與對手同步出閘，留居中間之後位置，走外疊。入直路時走大外疊。直路上略為追前，取得第四名。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W) Began well from gate 10, raced in midfield on the outside, very wide turning in, finished off strongly to take a place, nearest finish. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W) 自第十檔出閘迅速，居中間位置，走外疊。入直路時走大外疊。衝刺強勁，跑獲季軍。過終點時最為接近。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W4W) Close up early, gradually taken over 2L back in 5th and 3-wide without cover rounding home bend, weakened under pressure.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W4W) 早段緊隨領放馬。轉直路彎時逐漸留居第五位，落後逾兩個馬位，走第三疊，沒有遮擋。末段在催策下轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; Bumped at the start, dropped back to race towards the rear 5Ls off the pace, made some inroads towards the finish but failed to seriously threaten at any stage.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;起步時發生碰撞，墮居後列，落後領放馬五個馬位。末段略為追前，但從未能構成真正威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W2W2W) Waited with towards rear, struggled to hold position from 400m out, lost touch final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W2W2W) 居後列，留力候上。自四百米處起難以保持位置。最後二百米被拋離。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Maintained a position in midfield, came under pressure home turn and dropped away on straightening. (No Vet findings.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 居中間位置。直路彎受催策。入直路時墮退。（賽後接受獸醫檢查，並無發現任何明顯異常之處。）

formguide.comments_eng: Australian PPG, a 4-year-old gelding, by Cosmic Force out of the General Nediym mare Mira Chavali. Horses by the same sire include Jedi Spurs and King Alloy. He was given three trials for in Hong Kong. In the latest trial, he made the run and finished fifth, beaten by 2-1/2Ls, under slight pressure over 1050m AWT at Sha Tin on November 13. He’s probably not shaping like a first-up winner and this run will undoubtedly improve him.
formguide.comments_chi: 「星間力量」(Cosmic Force)之後，在港同父馬包括「星球勇士」及「皇金合」等駒，生母出自「力敵將軍」(General Nediym)。抵港後試閘三次。最近11月13日出試田泥1050米，早段領放，末段稍騎下跑第五名，落後頭馬2.5個馬位。應不足以一出即勝，仍需熱身去提升表現。

formguide.comments_eng: South African ISG , a 4-year-old gelding, by What A Winter out of the Querari mare Cosmic Light. Horses by the same sire include Mid Winter Wind and Armando. He was given five trials in Hong Kong. In the latest trial, he raced handily and finished seventh, beaten by 6-1/4Ls, under pressure over 1050m AWT at Sha Tin on November 10. He’s probably not looking like a first-up winner but this race will give us a chance to look at him more closely.
formguide.comments_chi: 「精彩冬日」(What A Winter)之後，在港同父馬包括「駿跑得」及「道道」等駒，生母出自Querari。抵港後試閘五次。最近11月10日出試田泥1050米，早段居前競跑，末段力策下跑第七名，落後頭馬6.25個馬位。不似能一出即勝，觀望為宜。

formguide.comments_eng: Australian PPG, a 4-year-old gelding, by Zoustar out of the Spring At Last mare Spring Venture. Horses by the same sire include Patch Of Theta and Stellar Express. He was given five trials in Hong Kong. In the latest trial, he made the run and finished eighth, beaten by 13-3/4Ls, under pressure over 1200m on turf in Conghua on November 2. He will probably need a run.
formguide.comments_chi: 「摘星勇驥」(Zoustar)之後，在港同父馬包括「手機錶霸」及「星際快車」等駒，生母出自Spring At Last。抵港後試閘五次。最近11月2日出試從化草地1200米，早段領放，末段力策下跑第八名，落後頭馬13.75個馬位。首戰熱身為主。

formguide.comments_eng: New Zealand PPG, a 4-year-old gelding, by Almanzor out of the I Am Invincible mare Majella Magic. Horses by the same sire include The Auspicious and Forerunner. He was given three trials for two wins and one placing in Hong Kong. He raced handily and won by 2Ls, under pressure over 1000m on turf in Conghua on October 12. In the latest trial, he raced handily and won by 2-3/4Ls, under pressure over 1000m on turf in Conghua on November 6. He looks an interesting debutant here.
formguide.comments_chi: 「好戰王」(Almanzor)之後，在港同父馬包括「豐辰」及「博愛先鋒」等駒，生母出自「至高無極」(I Am Invincible)。抵港後三次試閘得兩勝一位。10月12日出試從化草地1000米，早段居前競跑，末段力策下以兩個馬位之先勝出。最近11月6日出試從化草地1000米，早段居前競跑，末段力策下以2.75個馬位之先勝出。初出值得留意走勢。

formguide.comments_eng: Australian PPG, a 4-year-old gelding, by Zoustar out of the I Am Invincible mare Dollymolly. Horses by the same sire include Patch Of Theta and Stellar Express. This fellow was given three trials for one win and two placings in Hong Kong. He raced handily and finished second, beaten by a short-head, under pressure over 1000m on turf in Conghua on October 23. In the latest trial, he shared the lead and finished second, beaten by 1/2L, under slight pressure over 1050m AWT at Sha Tin on November 10. He looks an interesting debutant and could run well here.
formguide.comments_chi: 「摘星勇驥」(Zoustar)之後，在港同父馬包括「手機錶霸」及「星際快車」等駒，生母出自「至高無極」(I Am Invincible)。抵港後三次試閘得一勝兩位。10月23日出試從化草地1000米，早段居前競跑，末段力策下跑第二名，落後頭馬短馬頭位。最近11月10日出試田泥1050米，早段並頭領放，末段稍騎下跑第二名，落後頭馬半個馬位。初出應可交出良好表現。

formguide.comments_eng: Australian PPG, a 4-year-old gelding, by Russian Revolution out of the Tale Of The Cat mare Catch That Cat. Horses by the same sire include Glory Elite and Candlelight Dinner. He was given three trials for one win and one placing in Hong Kong. He sat midfield and won by 1L, under slight pressure over 1000m on turf at Sha Tin on October 13. In the latest trial, he sat midfield and finished fourth, beaten by 1-3/4Ls, under slight pressure over 1050m AWT at Sha Tin on November 10. He should run a decent race, with better to come.
formguide.comments_chi: 「俄式變革」(Russian Revolution)之後，在港同父馬包括「輝煌精英」及「燭光晚餐」等駒，生母出自Tale Of The Cat。抵港後三次試閘得一勝一位。10月13日出試田草1000米，早段居中，末段稍騎下以一個馬位之先勝出。最近11月10日出試田泥1050米，早段居中，末段稍騎下跑第四名，落後頭馬1.75個馬位。初出或有一定走勢，熱身後應會更進步。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Led on the outside rail, weakened final furlong. (See Incident Report)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;沿外欄領放。最後二百米轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Showed good speed to lead, edged right under pressure when challenged 100m out, headed 50m out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;展現甚快前速，取得領先。一百米處受挑戰，在催策下內閃。五十米處被超越。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W2W) Sat handy 2 wide, limited response when asked.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W2W) 居前列，走第二疊。對催策反應平平。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Chased leader, weakened passing 250M, never a threat.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 追趕領放馬。跑過二百五十米處時轉弱。從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; Bumped out of stalls and lost balance, tracked leaders, ridden along 400m out, weakened final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;出閘時被碰撞，失去平衡，跟隨領先馬匹。四百米處受催策。最後二百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; Jumped swiftly and cut across to the stands' rail, pressured for the lead throughout the event, run peaked at 200m and weakened gradually.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;出閘迅速，切向外欄。沿途在催策下爭奪領先。二百米處未能再增速，逐漸轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; Jumped well, raced prominently on the stands' side, 3/4L back at 400M, took the lead approaching final 100M, kept on well to the line and scored.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;出閘迅速，居前列，靠近外欄競跑。四百米處落後四分三個馬位。趨近一百米處時取得領先。保持佳勢至終點，掄元。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Sat in front of midfield 3 from the stands' rail, closed off nicely to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;居中間之前位置，走外欄第四疊。末段衝刺良佳。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; In rear on outside of field, followed winner through from 300m out, found that rival too strong but stayed on well.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;居馬群外側的後列位置。自三百米處起跟隨頭馬上前。未能與頭馬抗衡，但保持佳勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; Settled in rear of mid-field, short of room final 400m, not fully extended.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;居中間之後位置。最後四百米空位不足。未能全力施為。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Mid-field towards outer, headway alongside winner 300m out, run petered out final 150m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;居中間位置，離外欄競跑。三百米處與頭馬一同追前。最後一百五十米洩氣。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W) Raced keenly throughout and had to make a wide forward move from the 700M, ran out abruptly near the 150M, faded and eased down thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W) 沿途搶口。自七百米處起須自外疊發力上前。接近一百五十米處時急促向外斜跑，力竭，其後收慢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W1W) Shifted out at start and made contact, raced slightly behind midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, peaked early in straight, weakened and eased thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W1W) 起步時向外斜跑及觸碰對手，居中間稍後位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路初未能再增速，其後轉弱及收慢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W2W) Taken back to race at rear on the inside, 2 wide turning in, made some progress early in straight, peaked on run 150M, ran on evenly to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W2W) 留居後列，走內疊。入直路時走第二疊。直路初略為追前。一百五十米處未能再增速。末段以穩勢上前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good; (2W2W) Taken back from wide draw, stayed on past several rivals final 200m.
Blood in mouth.
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等步速;(2W2W) 自外檔出閘後留後。保持走勢，最後二百米超越數匹對手。
口內有血。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W1W) Soon prominent despite awkward start, settled within 3L of pace in 4th early in back straight gaining to 2L 3rd 650M out, saved ground on rail turning in but soon faded.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W1W) 出閘笨拙，但瞬即居前列。對面直路早段居第四位，落後領放馬不足三個馬位。六百五十米處進佔第三位，落後兩個馬位。入直路時走內欄節省腳程，但瞬即力竭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Jumped only fairly, raced slightly better than midfield on the stands' side, hard ridden from 350M but only showed limited response, weakened final furlong.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;出閘僅屬一般，居中間稍前位置，靠近外欄競跑。自三百五十米處起受力策，但反應僅屬平平。最後二百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W4W) Caught 3 wide no cover on pace, weakened and gave ground in the Straight. (Unacceptable performance)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W4W) 居前列，走第三疊，沒有遮擋。直路上轉弱及墮退。（表現難以接受。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Bumped start, raced better than midfield, 2 away from the stands' rail, peaked 300M, weakened thereafter. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;起步時與對手互相碰撞，居中間之前位置，走外欄第三疊。三百米處未能再增速，其後轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Sat towards the rear on the outside fence, made good late ground.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;居後列，走外欄。末段追前甚多。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W4W) Settled worse than midfield 2 wide, never quickened.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W4W) 居中間之後位置，走第二疊。未能加速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Fast; (4W7W) Jumped only fairly, settled down behind midfield 5Ls back, swung wide for home before running on at same pace early straight, eased when no chance.
(Roarer again.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
快步速;(4W7W) 出閘僅屬一般，居中間之後位置，落後五個馬位。轉直路彎時移出外疊。直路初上前，保持同速。在爭勝無望時收慢。
（再次患有喘鳴症。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Settled in front of midfield 2 wide, ran on fairly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 居中間之前位置，走第二疊。末段走勢一般。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W) Sat behind midfield, closed off fairly, limited response when asked.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W) 居中間之後位置。末段衝刺一般，對催策反應平平。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Settled midfield, traveled fairly, ran on evenly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 居中間位置，走勢一般。末段保持穩勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Moderately away, raced behind midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, kept on same pace to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 出閘普通，居中間之後位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。保持同速至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (3W3W) Sat worse than midfield, switched out entering the Straight, finished off well.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(3W3W) 居中間之後位置。入直路時向外移出。衝刺良佳。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W) Shifted out at start and bumped, raced at tail, 8 lengths back turning in, made good progress in straight to be nearest on line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W) 起步時向外斜跑，與對手互相碰撞，居包尾位置。入直路時落後八個馬位。直路上追前頗多，過終點時最為接近。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (6W2W3W) Content with letting the pace go and settled a tad worse than midfield, swung the widest turning in, rallied fairly well under reminders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(6W2W3W) 放棄爭奪領先，居中間稍後位置。入直路時移出最外疊。在催策下衝刺不俗。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (4W3W) Raced very wide throughout, mid division, struggled to maintain position from 600m out, left behind home straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(4W3W) 居中間位置，沿途走大外疊。自六百米處起難以保持位置。直路上被拋離。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W) Across to press leader, pushed along 500m out to chase leader, flattened out final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W) 切入以追迫領放馬。五百米處受推策，追趕領放馬。最後二百米洩氣。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (6W2W3W) Bustled along after the start to obtain a position ahead of midfield, shifted in abruptly 500M resulting in rider losing balance, failed to pick up pace in the straight. (Warning placed on the horse's racing manners.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(6W2W3W) 起步後受催策以佔取中間之前位置。五百米處急促向內斜跑，導致騎師失去平衡。直路上未能加速。（小組就此駒的走勢發出警告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W2W) Bumped start, raced 2 wide slightly better than midfield, angled out 350M, finished off very strongly, just beaten by a narrow margin, good debut.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W2W) 起步時發生碰撞，居中間稍前位置，走第二疊。三百五十米處向外移出。末段衝刺凌厲，僅以短距離之差落敗。在港初出表現不俗。

formguide.comments_eng: Australian PPG, a 4-year-old gelding, by Russian Camelot, who also sired Topspin King, out of the Foreplay mare Playtime. The fellow was given three trials for two placings in Hong Kong. He raced handily and finished second, beaten by 3/4L, under slight pressure over 1200m AWT at Sha Tin on October 16. In the latest trial, he sat not far behind the pace and finished second, beaten by 3/4Ls, under pressure over 1200m on turf in Conghua on November 2. He looks like a player here at the first time of asking.
formguide.comments_chi: 「俄式帝堡」(Russian Camelot)之後，另一匹在港同父馬為「尚旋」，生母出自「前奏」(Foreplay)。抵港後三次試閘兩次上名。10月16日出試田泥1200米，早段居前競跑，末段稍騎下跑第二名，落後頭馬0.75個馬位。最近11月2日出試從化草地1200米，早段落後領先馬匹不遠，末段力策下跑第二名，落後頭馬0.75個馬位。初出有一爭之力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Began only fairly, raced at rear, 6 lengths back in the middle stages, made no progress final 400M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;出閘僅屬一般，居後列。中段落後六個馬位。最後四百米毫無進展。

formguide.comments_eng: New Zealand PPG, a 4-year-old gelding, by Ardrossan out of the Domesday mare Famous Attraction. Horses by the same sire include Absolute Awakened and Audacious Pursuit. This fellow was given two trials for one placing in Hong Kong. He sat not far off the pace and finished third, beaten by 1-1/4Ls, under pressure over 1000m on turf in Conghua on October 5. In the latest trial, he sat midfield and finished fifth, beaten by 1-1/4Ls, under pressure over 1000m on turf in Conghua on October 23. He's a nice horse and could run well here on debut.
formguide.comments_chi: Ardrossan之後，在港同父馬包括「活力精神」及「大千雄心」等駒，生母出自Domesday。抵港後兩次試閘一次上名。10月5日出試從化草地1000米，早段落後領先馬匹不遠，末段力策下跑第三名，落後頭馬1.25個馬位。最近10月23日出試從化草地1000米，早段居中，末段力策下跑第五名，落後頭馬1.25個馬位。潛質不俗，預計初出會有良好走勢。

formguide.comments_eng: New Zealand PPG, a 4-year-old gelding, by Per Incanto out of the Pins mare Runway. Horses by the same sire include Raging Blizzard and Healthy Healthy. This fellow was given four trials in Hong Kong. In the latest trial, he sat midfield after jumping slowly and finished fifth, beaten by 5Ls, under pressure over 1200m AWT at Sha Tin on November 3. He will probably need a run.
formguide.comments_chi: Per Incanto之後，在港同父馬包括「精算暴雪」及「添開心」等駒，生母出自Pins。抵港後試閘四次。最近11月3日出試田泥1200米，出閘緩慢，早段居中，末段力策下跑第五名，落後頭馬五個馬位。首戰熱身為主。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Bumped start, raced 2 wide in midfield, there to turn, finished off evenly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 起步時發生碰撞，居中間位置，走第二疊。直路彎前居相同位置。末段以穩勢衝刺。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Moderately away, positioned 3 lengths behind the leader on the middle track, same margin back at 400M, kept on well to take a place without threatening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;出閘普通，落後領放馬三個馬位，在跑道中央競跑。四百米處落後相同距離。保持佳勢，跑入季席，但未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good to slow; Bumped out of stalls, challenged and every chance from 400m out, one paced and unable to get on terms with leaders.
(Lost left hind plate.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等偏慢步速;出閘時與對手互相碰撞。自四百米處起展開挑戰，一度甚具爭勝機會。末段保持同速，未能追上領先馬匹。
（失去左後蹄的蹄鐵。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W2W2W) Disputed lead early, tracked leaders after 400m, pushed along to hold position over 400m out, weakened home straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W2W2W) 早段爭奪領先。過了首四百米後跟隨領先馬匹。四百米處受推策以保持位置。直路上轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Jumped awkwardly, recovered to race mid-field, driven 400m out, one paced.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;出閘笨拙。恢復走勢，居中間位置。四百米處受催策，保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (3W3W) Jumped with them, raced 3 wide in midfield, no cover from 900M, a bit closer turning in, showed good response early in straight, took the lead 150M, peaked and headed 100M, weakened gradually final 50M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(3W3W) 與對手同步躍出，居中間位置，走第三疊。自九百米處起沒有遮擋。入直路時略為追近。直路早段對催策反應良佳。一百五十米處取得領先。一百米處未能再增速及被超越。最後五十米逐漸轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Slow; (1W3W) Slowly away, raced at rear on the inside, difficult to settle in the middle stages, angled out 600M, made some progress in straight. (See Racing Incidents.)
(Lame in right front leg.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
慢步速;(1W3W) 出閘緩慢，居後列，走內疊。中段難以穩定走勢。六百米處向外移出。直路上略為追前。（見競賽事件報告。）
（右前腿不良於行。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W1W) Jumped only fairly, taken back to race at rear on the inside, saved ground on turn, angled out early in straight, made no progress thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W1W) 出閘僅屬一般，留居後列，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路早段向外移出。其後毫無進展。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Slowly away, positioned 3 lengths behind the leader, hard ridden after passing 400M but only showed limited response, weakened final furlong.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;出閘緩慢，落後領放馬三個馬位。跑過四百米處後受力策，但反應僅屬平平。最後二百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W4W) Moderately away from gate 13, raced in midfield on the outside, no cover throughout, weakened early in straight when hard run took effect. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W4W) 自第十三檔出閘普通，居中間位置，走外疊，沿途沒有遮擋。耗力太多，直路初轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; Jumped with them, sent forward to take the lead, led by 1/4L at 400M, hard ridden from 350M, kept on well but unable to hold off the winner final 50M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;與對手同步躍出，受催策上前領放。四百米處領先四分一個馬位。自三百五十米處起受力策。保持佳勢，但最後五十米未能抗衡頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (2W2W) Commenced well, raced 2 wide better than midfield, there to turn, kept on well early in straight, peaked 100M, weakened gradually thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(2W2W) 出閘迅速，居中間之前位置，走第二疊。直路彎居相同位置。直路早段保持佳勢。一百米處未能再增速，其後逐漸轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W2W) Tracked leader, ridden top of home straight to chase leader, one paced under pressure.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W2W) 緊隨領放馬。直路初在催策下追趕領放馬。末段在催策下保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Crowded at start, settled in rear of mid-field, pushed along wide into home straight, never a factor.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 起步時受擠迫，居中間之後位置。入直路時受推策，走外疊。從未有力一爭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W) Made contact at start, taken back to race at tail, 5-1/4L back turning in, made very good progress in straight to take a place, nearest on line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W) 起步時發生觸碰，留居包尾位置。入直路時落後五又四分一個馬位。直路上追前甚多，跑入季席。過終點時最為接近。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (2W3W) Keen in rear, stayed on final 200m, lacked speed to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(2W3W) 居後列，搶口。最後二百米保持走勢。速度不足以展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W2W) Raced ahead of midfield and settled more forward than anticipated, ran home one paced final 400M posing little threat to leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W2W) 居中間之前位置，較賽前預期為前。最後四百米衝刺時保持同速，對領先馬匹無甚威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W2W) Slow to begin, sat last, stayed on well late.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W2W) 出閘緩慢，居包尾位置。末段保持佳勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Led, pressured by rival, headed over 200m out, faded.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 帶頭競跑，受對手追迫。二百米處被超越，其後力竭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W) Sat on pace 2 wide, unable to quickened.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W) 居前列，走第二疊。未能加速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W3W) Settled in front of midfield, raced wide, gave ground quickly in the Straight (See Incident Report).
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W3W) 居中間之前位置，走外疊。直路上迅速墮退。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W2W) Pushed on from a wide gate and sat outside the leader, fought on gamely to finish into placings.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W2W) 自外檔出閘後受推策，居領放馬外側。以佳勢力拼，跑獲季軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W4W) Shifted in at start and made contact, raced in midfield on outer, no cover throughout, peaked early in straight, weakened thereafter. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W4W) 起步時向內斜跑及發生觸碰，居中間位置，走外疊。沿途沒有遮擋。直路早段未能再增速，其後轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W1W) Sat behind the leaders, one pace when asked.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W1W) 居領先馬匹之後。在催策下保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W1W) Tracked leader, improved to lead 200m out, headed 75m out, no extra.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W1W) 跟隨領放馬。上前，二百米處取得領先。七十五米處被超越。再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (2W2W2W) Settled towards the rear 7-8Ls, had big task in hand turning for home, gave good response and came from a long way back to claim 4th.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(2W2W2W) 居後列，落後七至八個馬位。入直路時落後頗遠。對催策反應良佳，自遙遙落後的位置追前，取得第四名。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W3W) Dropped out from wide draw, under pressure throughout, widest into home straight, no impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W3W) 自外檔出閘後墮後。沿途受催策。入直路時走最外疊。毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W4W) Taken back from gate 13, raced at tail, 6 lengths back turning in, taken wide in straight and made some headway.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W4W) 自第十三檔出閘後留居包尾位置。入直路時落後六個馬位。直路上移出外疊，略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W3W) Shifted out and bumped exiting stalls, raced in rear, pushed along wide into home straight, made up some late ground.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W3W) 出閘時向外斜跑及被碰撞，居後列。入直路時受推策，走外疊。末段略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (2W3W) Settled midfield 2 wide, closed off strongly to score.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(2W3W) 居中間位置，走第二疊。末段衝刺強勁，掄元。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W3W) Settled towards rear, switched out rounding the Turn, made steady ground.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W3W) 居後列。轉直路彎時向外移出。末段以穩勢追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W1W) Rail position in rear of mid-field, pushed along 500m out, challenged up rail from 200m out, one paced under pressure.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W1W) 居中間之後位置，走內欄。五百米處受推策。自二百米處起沿內欄展開挑戰。在催策下保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (4W3W) Restrained after start but unable to find cover, fought hard in the straight to go 3rd passing 200M, held by first 2 late. (Rider made error of judgement early stages in not attempting to cross runners to his inside.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(4W3W) 起步後受約束，但未能取得遮擋。直路上力拼。跑過二百米處時進佔第三位。末段未能追上首兩名馬匹。（騎師於早段未有嘗試讓坐騎超越內側的對手屬判斷錯誤。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W2W) Settled in front of midfield on the rail, no clear run top of the Straight, closed off strongly once in the clear, won cozily.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W2W) 居中間之前位置，走內欄。直路初未能望空。末段望空後隨即以勁勢衝刺，從容獲勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W) Settled ahead of midfield in 5th spot, ran home one paced final 400M. Never going the pace to challenge. (No Vet findings.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W) 居中間之前的第五位。最後四百米保持同速。從未能加速上前展開挑戰。（賽後接受獸醫檢查，並無發現任何明顯異常之處。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W1W1W1W) Settled in front of midfield, traveled okay, ran on evenly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W1W1W1W) 居中間之前位置，走勢尚可。末段保持穩勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Midfield on rail early stages, made headway 1400M out to be 2L 3rd onto home bend, badly baulked for a run after straightening until the 300M, ran on to hold every chance throughout final stages.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 早段居中間位置，走內欄。千四米處上前。開始轉直路彎時居第三位，落後兩個馬位。入直路後嚴重受困直至三百米處。末段沿途保持走勢，一度甚具爭勝機會。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (2W2W) Jumped awkwardly, chased the leader, traveled smoothly, closed off nicely.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(2W2W) 出閘笨拙，追趕領放馬，走勢暢順。衝刺良佳。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (3W4W) Dropped out from widest draw, three wide without cover, pushed along widest into home straight, ran on strongly final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(3W4W) 自最外檔出閘後墮後，走第三疊，沒有遮擋。入直路時受推策，走最外疊。最後二百米以勁勢上前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (3W1W4W5W) Settled in rear from a wide barrier, taken back to last when carried wide first turn, trailed the field to the 700M, 4-wide rounding home bend swinging even wider into straight, made no impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(3W1W4W5W) 自外檔出閘，留居後列。首個彎位在被帶出較外疊時墮居包尾位置。七百米處前尾隨馬群。轉直路彎時走第四疊，入直路時走更外疊。末段毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W3W) Slightly slow out and crowded, raced 2 wide, 4 lengths or so back, 3 wide on turn, made some progress until approaching 50M, ran on evenly to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W3W) 起步略為緩慢及受擠迫，落後約四個馬位，走第二疊。直路彎走第三疊。略為追前直至趨近五十米處。末段走勢平穩。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W2W) Crowded shortly after start, raced behind midfield on the inside, 3 to 4 lengths back turning in, unable to obtain clear run early in straight, found daylight near 150M, made some progress thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W2W) 起步後不久受擠迫，居中間之後位置，走內疊。入直路時落後三至四個馬位。直路早段未能望空。接近一百五十米處時望空，其後略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W2W) Bumped out of stalls, pressed leaders, driven along 500m out to chase leaders, weakened quickly in home straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W2W) 出閘時發生碰撞，追迫領先馬匹。五百米處受催策，追趕領先馬匹。直路上迅速轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W3W) Made contact at start, positioned 3 wide, 3 lengths or so back, no cover on turn, kept on same pace in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W3W) 起步時發生觸碰，落後約三個馬位，走第三疊。直路彎沒有遮擋。直路上保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W2W3W3W) Settled well back from the widest draw, made short-lived effort between the 800 and 600M, made no further impression in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W2W3W3W) 自最外檔出閘後遙居於後。八百米處至六百米處之間一度發力。直路上再無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (3W5W) Dropped out from wide draw, pushed along wide into home straight, no extra final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(3W5W) 自外檔出閘後墮後。入直路時受推策，走外疊。最後二百米再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Rear of mid-field, travelled smoothly into home straight, ran on well final 200m to lead close home, bumped 100m out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 居中間之後位置。入直路時走勢暢順。最後二百米以佳勢上前，接近終點時取得領先。一百米處發生碰撞。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (4W3W) Jumped awkwardly, taken back to race behind midfield on the outside, a bit closer on turn, made contact near 500M, peaked early in straight, weakened 200M, eased final 150M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(4W3W) 出閘笨拙，留居中間之後位置，走外疊。直路彎略為追近。接近五百米處時發生觸碰。直路早段未能再增速。二百米處轉弱。最後一百五十米收慢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W3W) Sat on pace 2 wide, under pressure from the 600M, weakened from the 400M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W3W) 居前列，走第二疊。自六百米處起受催策。自四百米處起轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Jumped awkwardly settling in 5th some 3L back, hampered and lost position over 700M out, met minor interference 400M out and dropped out noticeably.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 出閘笨拙，居第五位，落後約三個馬位。七百米處受阻礙，失位。四百米處略為受干擾，顯著墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (3W3W) Began well from gate 12, raced prominently, 3 wide, there to turn, hit the front 150M, kept on well to the line and scored. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(3W3W) 自第十二檔出閘迅速，居前列，走第三疊。直路彎前居相同位置。一百五十米處取得領先。保持佳勢至終點，勝出賽事。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Prominent early, gradually drifted backward to 10th some 5L off the pace by the 800M, saved ground turning in for home, faded inside final 150M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 早段居前列。逐漸墮後，八百米處居第十位，落後領放馬約五個馬位。轉入直路時走內疊節省腳程。最後一百五十米力竭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W1W) Moderately away from gate 1, raced in midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, showed limited response early in straight, weakened final furlong.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W1W) 自第一檔出閘普通，居中間位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路初對催策反應平平。最後二百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W) Shifted in at start and made contact, raced better than midfield on the outside, no cover for the majority of the race, 3 lengths back turning in, peaked early in straight, weakened final 250M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W) 起步時向內斜跑，發生觸碰，居中間之前位置，走外疊。大部分途程沒有遮擋。入直路時落後三個馬位。直路初未能再加速。最後二百五十米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W3W) Awkward start and lost ground, rail position in mid-field, angled out to make run 600m out, didn't get best of runs in home straight, promising.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W3W) 起步笨拙及失地，居中間位置，走內欄。六百米處向外移出取位。直路上取位不太暢順。表現不俗。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W2W) Slightly inconvenienced at start, raced behind midfield on the inside, moved a bit closer along the rail on turn, 2 wide from 450M, finished off well to take 2nd without threatening the winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W2W) 起步時略受妨礙，居中間之後位置，走內疊。直路彎沿欄略為追近。自四百五十米處起走第二疊。末段衝刺良佳，跑獲亞軍，但未能威脅頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W) Taken back from gate 12, raced at rear, 8-1/2L back turning in, made very good progress in straight to take a place, nearest on line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W) 自第十二檔起步後留居後列。入直路時落後八個半馬位。直路上追前甚多，取得季軍，過終點時最為接近。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W) Began only fairly, raced 3 wide with cover behind midfield, 4 lengths back, similar position on turn, no clear run until final 50M, ran on evenly thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W) 出閘僅屬一般，居中間之後位置，落後四個馬位，走第三疊，有遮擋。直路彎位置相若。未能望空直至五十米處。其後保持穩勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Sat at the rear, made good late ground.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 居後列。末段追前甚多。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Began only fairly, raced towards rear on the inside, saved ground on turn, made some progress in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 出閘僅屬一般，居後列，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路上略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (2W1W) Jumped well, sent forward to take the lead, led by 1/4L turning in, challenged by rival early in straight, peaked and headed 300M, weakened final 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(2W1W) 出閘迅速，受催策上前領放。入直路時領先四分一個馬位。直路早段受對手挑戰。三百米處未能再增速及被超越。最後一百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow(+) (3W1W) Ridden along from stalls to get across, kicked 400m out, headed by winner 150m out, stuck to task.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速(+)(3W1W) 出閘後受催策，切入內疊。四百米處加速。一百五十米處被頭馬超越。其後保持走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W) Mid-field, ridden along into home straight, weakened final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W) 居中間位置。入直路時受催策。最後二百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W4W) From draw 10 settled towards the rear further back than intended, caught 3-wide throughout, had work to do top of the straight but was only one paced to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W4W) 自第十檔出閘，居較賽前部署為後的後列位置。沿途走第三疊。直路初落後頗遠，但僅能保持同速至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Settled in front of midfield 2 wide, angled out in the Straight, closed off strongly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 居中間之前位置，走第二疊。直路上向外移出。衝刺強勁。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Raced in rear after slow start, plenty to do 400m out and switched towards centre of track, stayed on, never nearer.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;出閘緩慢，居後列。四百米處落後甚遠，移至跑道中央。保持走勢，以末段最為接近。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; Raced in rear after slowly away, pushed along towards centre of course 350m out, stayed on steadily.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;出閘緩慢，居後列。三百五十米處在跑道中央受推策。保持穩勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Slightly slow out and crowded, raced towards rear on the inside, saved ground on turn, kept on same pace in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 出閘稍慢，受擠迫，居後列，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路上保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W) Sat rear, traveled on the rail, minor progress made (See Incident Report).
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W) 居後列，走內欄。末段略為上前。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W1W) Settled midfield on the rail, stayed on.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W1W) 居中間位置，走內欄。保持走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Waited with in rear against rail, under pressure 600m out, switched wide for clear run 200m out, forced to steady 100m out, unable to be ridden out to finish.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 居後列，走內欄，留力候上。六百米處受催策。二百米處移出外疊以望空。一百米處被迫收慢。末段未能被力策。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W) Raced in rear, had to wait for run top of home straight, forced to steady 200m out, ran on well final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W) 居後列。直路初須等待空位出現。二百米處被迫收慢，其後走勢良佳。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (1W1W) Sat midfield on the rail, made good ground in the Straight, just unable to hold off the winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(1W1W) 居中間位置，走內欄。直路上追前甚多，僅未能抗衡頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W4W) Checked on jumping, sat rear, minor progress made when asked.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W4W) 躍出時勒避，居後列。在催策下略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W1W) Jumped awkwardly, taken back to race at rear, travelled keenly after passing 800M, 3-1/2L back turning in, one-paced in the run home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W1W) 出閘笨拙，留居後列。跑過八百米處後搶口。入直路時落後三個半馬位。直路上保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (2W3W5W) Settled in last few from a poor draw, never seen with a chance.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(2W3W5W) 自第十檔出閘，居最後數位之內。從未有力一爭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W1W) Slowly into stride from wide draw, raced in last place, pushed along and a bit detached 500m out, good late headway final 150m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W1W) 自外檔出閘緩慢，居包尾位置。受推策，五百米處稍被拋離。最後一百五十米追前甚多。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W3W3W) Mid-field, struggling from halfway, dropped to last 300m out, well beaten.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W3W3W) 居中間位置。自半程起掙扎上前。三百米處墮居包尾位置。所負甚遠。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) One of the quickest out, tried to stay in touch in midfield but did not travel at any stage of the race, gave ground quickly final 400M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 出閘最快的其中一駒。嘗試保持居於中間位置，但全程走勢欠順。最後四百米迅速墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Bumped start, raced 2 wide in midfield, weakened from 500M, eased final furlong, unacceptable performance.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 起步時發生碰撞，居中間位置，走第二疊。自五百米處起轉弱，最後二百米收慢。表現難以接受。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Bumped heavily out of stalls, raced in touch with leaders, under pressure 500m out, dropped away quickly in home straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 出閘時發生大力碰撞，跟隨領先馬匹。五百米處受催策。直路上迅速墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; Bumped and unbalanced shortly after start, raced at rear throughout, never a factor.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;起步後不久被碰撞，失去平衡。沿途居後列。從未有力一爭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W3W) Sat on pace 2 wide, unable to quickened.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W3W) 居前列，走第二疊。未能加速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W3W) Began moderately, never better than midfield and 3-wide most of the way, obtained a clear passage over 300M out but unable to quicken to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W3W) 出閘普通，從未超越中間位置，大部分途程走第三疊。三百米處望空，但未能加速以展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W2W) Tracked leaders, ridden along 400m out, well placed into home straight, one paced under pressure.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W2W) 跟隨領先馬匹。四百米處受催策。入直路時居好位。在催策下保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Settled in front of midfield 2 wide, kept on nicely.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 居中間之前位置，走第二疊。末段保持佳勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W) Sat on pace 2 wide, kept on without threatening top 3.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W) 居前列，走第二疊。末段保持走勢，未能威脅三甲馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W3W) Caught 3-wide without cover chasing leaders, couldn't sustain run passing 350M and weakened away.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W3W) 追趕領先馬匹，走第三疊，沒有遮擋。跑過三百五十米處時無以為繼，轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W4W) Began awkwardly, trailed the field to straight, widest turning in for home, only ran past well-beaten horses.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W4W) 出閘笨拙。直路前尾隨馬群。轉入直路時走最外疊。僅能超越已洩氣潰敗的對手。

raceinfo_chi.RaceName: 中銀香港中銀理財讓賽

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (1W5W) Held up last, pushed along widest into home straight, ran on strongly to close on winner, just failed.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(1W5W) 留居包尾位置。入直路時受推策，走最外疊。末段以勁勢上前，追近頭馬，僅敗。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Slightly slow out, raced 2 wide towards rear, a bit closer on turn, no clear run early in straight, cleared 300M, finished off strongly, just beaten by a head.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 出閘稍慢，居後列，走第二疊。直路彎略為追近。直路早段未能望空。三百米處望空，末段衝刺強勁，僅以一馬頭位之差見負。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (1W3W) Crowded and forced to steady at start, towards rear, pushed along widest top of home straight, ran on well final 200m but hung in, no match for winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(1W3W) 起步時受擠迫及被迫收慢，居後列。直路初受推策，走最外疊。最後二百米以佳勢上前，但內閃。不敵頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W3W) Held up last after slowly away, pushed along widest into home straight, hung in but ran on strongly to close on leaders, only beaten narrowly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W3W) 出閘緩慢，留居包尾位置。入直路時受推策，走最外疊。內閃，但以勁勢上前，追近領先馬匹。僅以短距離見負。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W2W) Slightly slow out and blundered, raced at rear, 6 lengths or so back turning in, made good progress in straight to be nearest on line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W2W) 出閘稍慢及失蹄，居包尾位置。入直路時落後約六個馬位。直路上追前甚多，過終點時最為接近。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W4W) Three wide in rear of mid-field without cover, smooth headway on bend, tended to hang in throughout in home straight, lost balance when rider placed significant pressure to his left rein 200m out, stayed on strongly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W4W) 居中間之後位置，走第三疊，沒有遮擋。直路彎追前，走勢暢順。直路上沿途傾向內閃。此駒於二百米處騎師大力收緊左邊韁繩時失去平衡，其後保持勁勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W2W) Moderately away, taken back to race at rear on the inside, 5 to 6 lengths back turning in, angled out early in straight, made some headway but was inclined to hang in final furlong. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W2W) 出閘普通，留居後列，走內疊。入直路時落後五至六個馬位。直路初向外移出。最後二百米略為追前，但傾向內閃。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (1W1W) Jumped with them, raced in midfield on the inside, 2 lengths or so back turning in, kept on well in straight to take 2nd, no threat to the winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(1W1W) 與對手同步躍出，居中間位置，走內疊。入直路時落後約兩個馬位。直路上保持佳勢，跑獲亞軍，但未能威脅頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (5W3W) Waited with towards rear, pushed along wide into home straight, briefly hampered 400m out, stayed on.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(5W3W) 居後列，留力候上。入直路時受推策，走外疊。四百米處一度受阻。保持走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (2W3W) Settled in mid-field, travelled strongly into home straight, ran on strongly to lead 100m out, pressed by runner-up to line and just prevailed.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(2W3W) 居中間位置。入直路時走勢強勁。以勁勢上前，一百米處取得領先。末段被亞軍馬匹追迫，僅勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Settled in mid-field, pushed along halfway out, strong run final 200m to lead close home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 居中間位置。半程時受推策。最後二百米走勢強勁，接近終點時取得領先。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Away well, sent forward to take the lead, led by a length in the middle stages, peaked and headed 250M, weakened final furlong. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 出閘迅速，受催策上前取得領先。中段領先一個馬位。二百五十米處未能再增速，被超越。最後二百米轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W4W) Bumped on jumping, driven forward chasing leaders in a 3-wide spot without cover, checked by the riderless horse at 450M, couldn't go on in the straight. (No Vet findings.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W4W) 躍出時發生碰撞，受催策上前追趕領先馬匹，走第三疊，沒有遮擋。四百五十米處勒避鞍上無人的馬匹。直路上無以為繼。（賽後接受獸醫檢查，並無發現任何明顯異常之處。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Across to lead from wide draw after 300m, ran on well for pressure final 200m and always holding runner-up by clear margin.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 自大外檔出閘，跑了三百米後切入領放。最後二百米在催策下以佳勢上前，一直帶離亞軍馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W4W) Jumped well from the widest draw, raced better than midfield on the outside, no cover throughout, peaked early in straight, weakened gradually final 150M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W4W) 自最外檔出閘迅速，居中間之前位置，走外疊。沿途沒有遮擋。直路初未能再增速。最後一百五十米逐漸轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W) Three wide in mid-field without cover, wide into home straight, stayed on but lacked pace to reach leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W) 居中間位置，走第三疊，沒有遮擋。入直路時走外疊。保持走勢，但未能加速以追及領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (3W3W) Shifted out at start, raced in midfield on the outside, no cover for the majority of the race, dropped towards rear on turn, 6 lengths back turning in, made no progress in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(3W3W) 起步時向外斜跑，居中間位置，走外疊。大部分途程沒有遮擋。直路彎墮居後列。入直路時落後六個馬位。直路上毫無進展。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W) Disputed lead, unable to match winner from 300m line but stuck to task.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W) 爭奪領先。自三百米處起未能追上頭馬，但持續力拼。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (4W3W) Commenced well, raced better than midfield on the outside, no cover throughout, peaked early in straight, weakened final furlong.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(4W3W) 出閘迅速，居中間之前位置，走外疊。沿途沒有遮擋。直路早段未能再增速，最後二百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Tracked leaders against rail, tended to hang out throughout, forced to steady on heels 700m out, lost touch final 300m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 跟隨領先馬匹，走內欄。沿途傾向外閃。七百米處被迫收慢避開他駒後蹄。最後三百米被拋離。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Controlled the tempo up front after a quick getaway, fought bravely final stages only fell short to a classy horse.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 出閘迅速，其後上前，主宰步速。末段奮勇力拼，僅負於實力強勁的一駒，所負不遠。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W) Slightly impeded leaving stalls, waited with in rear, pushed along wide top of home straight, passed a few tiring rivals late on.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W) 出閘時略為受阻，居後列，留力候上。直路初受推策，走外疊。末段超越數匹漸呈疲態的對手。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (3W5W) Taken back to race 3 wide behind midfield, 6 lengths back turning in, made no impression in straight. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(3W5W) 留居中間之後位置，走第三疊。入直路時落後六個馬位。直路上毫無表現。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Stood flat-footed on jumping and lost ground, raced in rear, ridden along 300m out, stayed on but no further impression on front two late on.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 躍出時四蹄滯立及失地，居後列。三百米處受催策，保持走勢，但末段未能進一步威脅首兩名馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W2W) Rail position in mid-field, driven along 500m out, tight for room early in home straight, stayed on steadily.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W2W) 居中間位置，走內欄。五百米處受催策。直路早段受緊迫。保持穩勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Held up last, pushed along 500m out, still in rear top of home straight, no impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 留居包尾位置。五百米處受推策。直路初仍居後列。毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W2W) Rail position in mid-field, forced to steady on heels 700m out, angled off rail top of home straight, ran on strongly final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W2W) 居中間位置，走內欄。七百米處被迫收慢避開他駒後蹄。直路初移離內欄。最後二百米走勢強勁。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W1W) Bounded as stalls opened and lost ground, in rear, pushed along 500m out, stayed on steadily.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W1W) 開閘時向上跳躍，失地，居後列。五百米處受推策。末段保持穩勢。

formguide.comments_eng: Australian PP, a 4-year-old gelding, by Written Tycoon out of the I Am Invincible mare Viddora. Horses by the same sire include Sing Dragon and Jumbo Treasure. This fellow had eleven starts for two wins (including a 3yo group three over 1300m) and five placings (including a 3yo listed over 1100m). He was given four trials for one placing in Hong Kong. He shared the lead and finished third, beaten by 1-1/4Ls, under slight pressure over 1200m AWT in at Sha Tin on November 3. In the latest trial, he sat midfield and finished fifth, beaten by 2-1/4Ls, under pressure over 1200m AWT in Sha Tin on November 13. He looks a nice horse and could run well here on debut.
formguide.comments_chi: 「千秋巨子」(Written Tycoon)之後，在港同父馬包括「昇瀧駒」及「寶進」等駒，生母出自「至高無極」(I Am Invincible)。來港前在澳洲十一戰得兩勝五位，頭馬包括一場1300米三歲三級賽，上名賽事包括一場1100米三歲表列賽。抵港後四次試閘一次上名。11月3日出試田泥1200米，早段並頭領放，末段稍騎下跑第三名，落後頭馬1.25個馬位。最近11月13日出試田泥1200米，早段居中，末段力策下跑第五名，落後頭馬2.25個馬位。潛質不俗，預計初出會有良好走勢。

formguide.comments_eng: Australian PP, a 4-year-old gelding, by The Autumn Sun out of the Shamardal mare Time Check. Horses by the same sire include Sky Jewellery and Another Zonda. This fellow had seven starts for three wins (three handicaps, over 1000m, 1200m and 1600m) and two placings. He was given three trials for one win in Hong Kong. He sat midfield and win by 3-3/4Ls, under pressure over 1200m on turf in Conghua on October 12. In the latest trial, he sat not far behind the pace and finished fifth, beaten by 3/4L, under a hold over 1200m on turf in Conghua on November 6. He looks like a player here at the first time of asking.
formguide.comments_chi: 「秋陽」(The Autumn Sun)之後，在港同父馬包括「首飾天空」及「暴風之子」等駒，生母出自Shamardal。來港前在澳洲七戰得三勝兩位，頭馬為三場讓賽，途程分別為1000米、1200米及1600米。抵港後三次試閘得一勝。10月12日出試從化草地1200米，早段居中，末段力策下以3.75個馬位之先勝出。最近11月6日出試從化草地1200米，早段落後領先馬匹不遠，末段按韁下跑第五名，落後頭馬0.75個馬位。初出有力一爭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W1W1W1W) From draw 2 had an economic run along the fence in mid-division, came under pressure home turn, found nothing and dropped out sharply. (Jockey - his mount failed to travel.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W1W1W1W) 自第二檔出閘，居中間位置，沿欄競跑節省腳程。直路彎受催策。末段再無餘力，急劇墮退。（騎師表示，坐騎沿途走勢欠順。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W1W1W1W) Sat on pace on the rail, weakened final furlong. (See Incident Report)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W1W1W1W) 居前列，走內欄。最後二百米轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W1W2W) Box seat, challenged and every chance from 400m out, ran on well but always held, lost out only narrowly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W1W2W) 居包廂位置。自四百米處起展開挑戰，一度甚具爭勝機會。以佳勢上前，但一直落後，僅以短距離之差落敗。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Very fast; (1W1W1W1W) Sat on pace, traveled smoothly, responded nicely under whip.
(Blood in trachea.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
極快步速;(1W1W1W1W) 居前列，走勢暢順。對鞭策反應良佳。
（氣管有血。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W3W4W) Raced in mid-pack but stayed close enough to leaders, picked up well when urged along near 400M, led early straight before keeping on well to the line. Just couldn't hold off winner final stages.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W3W4W) 居中間位置，但保持落後領先馬匹不遠。接近四百米處時在催策下以佳勢加速。直路初領先，其後保持佳勢至終點。僅於末段未能抗衡頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W2W2W2W) Close up early restraining one-out-one-back to 4th rounding first bend, drifted back to 6th on restraint about 750M out, kept on steadily under pressure in straight without threatening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W2W2W2W) 早段緊隨領先馬匹。轉首個彎位時受約束，居第二疊第二位，即馬群中的第四位。約七百五十米處在約束下墮居第六位。直路上在催策下保持穩勢，未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Bumped after the start, obtained running in midfield, driven along 500M but not going the pace to challenge, weakened 200M. (Jockey - would be better suited by stepping up in distance.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 起步後發生碰撞，居中間位置。五百米處受催策，但未能加速以展開挑戰。二百米處轉弱。（騎師表示，坐騎下仗若可增程角逐將更適合發揮。）

formguide.comments_eng: Australian PP, a 4-year-old gelding, by Dubious from Tinjirarni, a daughter of Exceed And Excel. Horses by the same sire include Patch Of Lucky and Metal King. This fellow had seven starts for one win (a 3yo+ maiden over 1100m) and four placings. He was given four trials for one win and two placings in Hong Kong. He sat not far behind the pace and finished second, beaten 2-1/4Ls, under pressure over 1000m on turf in Conghua on September 21. In the latest trial, he sat midfield and finished second, beaten by a neck, under pressure, over 1200m AWT at Sha Tin on November 5. He should run a decent race, with better to come.
formguide.comments_chi: Dubious之後，在港同父馬包括「錶之福將」及「有色光輝」，生母出自「盡善盡美」(Exceed And Excel)。來港前在澳洲七戰得一勝四位，頭馬為一場1100米三歲及以上從未勝出馬賽。抵港後四次試閘得一勝兩位。9月21日出試從化草地1000米，早段落後領先馬匹不遠，末段力策下跑第二名，落後頭馬2.25個馬位。最近11月5日出試田泥1200米，早段居中，末段力策下跑第二名，落後頭馬一馬頸位。初出或有一定走勢，熱身後應會更進步。

formguide.comments_eng: Australian PP, a 4-year-old gelding, by Peltzer out of the Fastnet Rock mare Infinite Love. He will be the first runner of his sire in Hong Kong. This fellow had one start for one win (a maiden over 1400m) in New Zealand. He was given three trials for two wins and one placing in Hong Kong. He raced handily and finished second, beaten by a neck, under slight pressure over 1200m on turf in Conghua on October 23. In the latest trial, he raced handily and won by 1/2L, under pressure over 1200m on turf in Conghua on November 2. Prefer to take a watching brief to see how he shapes at his local debut.
formguide.comments_chi: Peltzer之後，是此父系首匹在港上陣馬，生母出自「燈塔島」(Fastnet Rock)。來港前在紐西蘭一出一捷，頭馬為一場1400米從未勝出馬賽。抵港後三次試閘得兩勝一位。10月23日出試從化草地1200米，早段居前競跑，末段稍騎下跑第二名，落後頭馬一馬頸位。最近11月2日出試從化草地1200米，早段居前競跑，末段力策下以半個馬位之先勝出。初出暫宜觀望。
