formguide.comments_eng: Australian PP, a 4-year-old gelding, by Admire Mars out of the Al Maher mare Al Pheroz. Horses by the same sire include Harmony N Joy and Sassphire. This fellow had seven starts for one win (a maiden handicap over 1700m). He was given three trials for one win in Hong Kong. He sat midfield and won by 3/4L, under pressure over 1200m on turf in Conghua on October 23. In the latest trial, he sat midfield after an awkward start and finished seventh, beaten by 7-1/4Ls, under slight pressure over 1200m AWT at Sha Tin on November 5. He will probably need a run.
formguide.comments_chi: 「頌讚火星」(Admire Mars)之後，在港同父馬包括「人和家盈」及「睿麗人生」等駒，生母出自Al Maher。來港前在澳洲七戰得一勝，頭馬為一場1700米從未勝出馬讓磅賽。抵港後三次試閘得一勝。10月23日出試從化草地1200米，早段居中，末段力策下以0.75個馬位之先勝出。最近11月5日出試田泥1200米，起步笨拙，早段居中，末段稍騎下跑第七名，落後頭馬7.25個馬位。首戰熱身為主。

formguide.comments_eng: French PP, a 3-year-old gelding, by Goken out of the Kheleyf mare Zala Chope. He will be the first runner of his sire in Hong Kong. This fellow had eight starts for one win (a maiden over 1200m on Tapeta) and five placings in Britain. He was given three trials for one placing in Hong Kong. In the latest trial, he raced handily and finished third, beaten by a short-head, under a hold over 1200m on turf in Conghua on November 6. Prefer to take a watching brief to see how he shapes at his local debut.
formguide.comments_chi: Goken之後，是此父系首匹在港上陣馬，生母出自Kheleyf。來港前在英國八戰得一勝五位，頭馬為一場1200米從未勝出馬賽(Tapeta)。抵港後三次試閘一次上名。最近11月6日出試從化草地1200米，早段居前競跑，末段按韁下跑第三名，落後頭馬短馬頭位。初出暫宜觀望。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W2W2W) Waited with towards rear, had to wait for run turning into home straight, made up some late ground but never dangerous.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W2W2W) 居後列，留力候上。轉入直路時須等待空位出現。末段略為追前，但從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Tracked leaders, well placed into home straight, unable to pick up for pressure from 400m out, flattened out final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 跟隨領先馬匹。入直路時居好位。自四百米處起受催策，但未能加速。最後二百米洩氣。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W4W) Three wide in mid-field with cover, under pressure to maintain position from 600m out, gave ground final 300m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W4W) 居中間位置，走第三疊，有遮擋。自六百米處起在催策下保持位置。最後三百米墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (3W4W) Three wide in mid-field, jumped a section on the track 1250m out, hampered 900m out, pushed along wide into home straight, ran on well but no match for winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(3W4W) 居中間位置，走第三疊。一千二百五十米處跳避跑道上的影子。九百米處受阻礙。入直路時受推策，走外疊。末段以佳勢上前，但不敵頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W2W) Jumped nicely, sat outside the lead, kept on well to score.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W2W) 出閘迅速，居領放馬外側。保持佳勢，掄元。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W) Made all, pressed on 350m out and soon in command, kicked two lengths clear 100m out and in control, won cosily.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W) 領放。三百五十米處受催策，瞬即控制大局。一百米處加速帶離兩個馬位，穩操勝券。從容獲勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W2W) Bumped start, raced towards rear, saved ground on turn, made good progress in straight to be nearest on line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W2W) 起步時發生碰撞，居後列。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路上追前甚多，過終點時最為接近。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W3W) Began only fairly, raced 2 wide behind midfield, angled out after passing 500M, 4-1/2L back turning in, made some headway in the run home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W3W) 出閘僅屬一般，居中間之後位置，走第二疊。跑過五百米處後向外移出。入直路時落後四個半馬位。末段略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W2W) Dropped out last from wide draw, hung right under pressure 400m out, good headway final 200m, ran on strongly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W2W) 自大外檔出閘後墮居包尾位置。四百米處在催策下內閃。最後二百米追前甚多。以勁勢上前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W2W2W) Settled in mid-field, ridden along 450m out, bumped and hampered 300m out, stayed on steadily.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W2W2W) 居中間位置。四百五十米處受催策。三百米處發生碰撞及受阻礙。末段保持穩勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Crowded and forced to steady exiting stalls, raced in rear, still in rear top of home straight, eye-catching headway from rear final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 出閘時受擠迫，被迫收慢，居後列。直路初仍居後列。最後二百米自後列追前，走勢悅目。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W4W) Held up last, lost balance and lost ground 800m out, pushed along widest into home straight, no impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W4W) 留居包尾位置。八百米處失去平衡及失地。入直路時受推策，走最外疊。毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Slowly away, rail position in mid-field, ridden along 550m out, unable to reach leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 出閘緩慢，居中間位置，走內欄。五百五十米處受催策。未能追上領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (3W2W2W3W) Chased leaders 2-wide in a fast run race, under the pump passing 500M, weakened 250M. (Jockey - uncomfortable on the surface which had been affected by some rain.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(3W2W2W3W) 在快步速下追趕領先馬匹，走第二疊。跑過五百米處時受催策。二百五十米處轉弱。（騎師表示，坐騎不適應在受微雨影響的場地競跑。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W1W1W1W) Led steadily first half of the race, quickened up pace from 800M, kept going well in the straight and was only caught by winner late stages.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W1W1W1W) 前半段以平穩步速領放。自八百米處起加速。直路上保持佳勢，僅於末段被頭馬超越。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W1W1W) Clean jump, took the lead, travelled comfortably to turn, kicked clear early in straight, kept on well to the line and scored.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W1W1W) 出閘俐落，取得領先。直路彎前走勢暢順。直路初加速帶離對手。保持佳勢至終點，勝出賽事。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W1W1W1W) Driven to the lead as expected, travelled well enough during the race, was nicely clear mid-straight only to be caught by first two close home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W1W1W1W) 一如預期受催策以取得領先。陣上走勢良佳。直路中段以佳勢帶離對手，僅於接近終點時被頭兩名馬匹超越。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (2W2W2W2W) Pressed leader, challenged winner top of home straight, joined winner 200m out, weakened final 50m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(2W2W2W2W) 追迫領放馬。直路初挑戰頭馬。二百米處追上頭馬。最後五十米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow(+) (1W1W) From wide draw went forward and crossed to the lead 1400M, fought hard to stay in contention on straightening, headed nearing 100M and faded to 4th late.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速(+)(1W1W) 自大外檔出閘後上前，千四米處切入領放。入直路時力拼以保持爭逐機會。接近一百米處時被超越。末段力弱，跑獲第四名。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (3W1W1W1W) Jumped well from a wide draw, sent forward to take the lead, shared lead turning in, peaked and headed 300M, weakened final furlong. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(3W1W1W1W) 自外檔出閘迅速，在催策下上前領放。入直路時並排領先。三百米處未能再增速，被超越。最後二百米轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(-) (2W2W2W3W) Tracked pace, shuffled back into mid-field 800m out, three wide final bend, good headway to lead 200m out, headed and no extra 50m out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(-)(2W2W2W3W) 跟隨領放馬。八百米處墮居中間位置。直路彎走第三疊。以佳勢上前，二百米處取得領先。五十米處被超越，再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good(+) (2W2W2W2W) From draw 12 moved up to track leader in a steadily run race, never gave up on straightening only to be gunned down by the winner closing stages.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速(+)(2W2W2W2W) 自第十二檔出閘後上前，跟隨領放馬，賽事步速平穩。入直路時持續力拼。末段僅不敵頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast(-) (1W1W1W1W) Fast into stride, chased leader on settling, in a good place to pounce but couldn't find the kick under 135lb, just battled home for minor placing.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速(-)(1W1W1W1W) 出閘迅速，追趕領放馬。居於有利爭勝的位置，但在負一百三十五磅下未能增速。末段力拼，僅保住季席。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W4W) Began well from the widest barrier before taking back to share 7th 3-wide after the first 300M, drifted some 6L back to 9th 1200M out, fought on steadily under pressure inside final 300M to claim 4th 50M out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W4W) 自大外檔出閘迅速，過了首三百米後留後，並居第七位，走第三疊。千二米處墮居第九位，落後約六個馬位。最後三百米在催策下持續力拼。五十米處進佔第四位。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W3W) Tracked leaders, blocked off when trying to switch 500m out, didn't get best of runs in home straight when trying to improve.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W3W) 跟隨領先馬匹。五百米處在嘗試轉換跑線之際受困。直路上嘗試推進上前，但取位不太暢順。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (4W2W1W2W) Pressed forward from a wide barrier to join the leader on first bend, chased within 2L of pace in back straight, similar turning for home when unable to quicken to challenge and swamped inside final 200M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(4W2W1W2W) 自外檔出閘，受催策上前，在首個彎位追上領放馬。對面直路上落後領放馬不逾兩個馬位。轉直路彎時居相若位置，未能加速以展開挑戰。最後二百米被後上馬匹超越。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (4W3W3W6W) Three wide in rear of mid-field, pushed along wide into home straight, unable to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(4W3W3W6W) 居中間之後位置，走第三疊。入直路時受推策，走外疊。未能展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (1W1W1W2W) Mid-field, angled off rail final bend, chased leaders, stayed on well to lead 50m out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(1W1W1W2W) 居中間位置。直路彎移離內欄。追趕領先馬匹，保持佳勢，五十米處取得領先。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow(-) (2W4W) Jumped awkwardly and given a waiting ride after the start, shuffled back to the rear when pace slackened middle stages, had task in hand 400M and made up some ground in the run home for a non-threatening 4th.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速(-)(2W4W) 出閘笨拙，其後留力候上。賽事中段步速減慢時墮居後列。四百米處落後甚遠。末段略為追前，取得第四名，未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W4W) Dropped out from widest draw, held up last, commenced move out wide 700m out, lacked pace to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W4W) 自大外檔出閘，墮居包尾位置。七百米處開始發力，走外疊。速度不足以展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W1W1W3W) Eased back to sit in a rearward position 7Ls off the fast pace, shuffled back to last spot making the home turn, brought wide to challenge and finished off mildly to take a non-threatening 4th.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W1W1W3W) 收慢留居後列，落後步速甚快的領放馬七個馬位。轉直路彎時墮居包尾位置。移出外疊以展開挑戰。末段衝刺普通，取得第四名，未能威脅三甲馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W1W) From wide draw given a conservative ride at the rear, had plenty to make up 400M but failed to pick up pace.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W1W) 自外檔出閘，留居後列。四百米處落後甚遠，但未能加速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W2W3W3W) Restrained to race in second half of the field, travelled keenly, lost cover from 900M strode forward to chase leaders, run ended mid-straight and had no extra late.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W2W3W3W) 受約束，居後半馬群中，跑來搶口。自九百米處起展步上前追趕領先馬匹，失去遮擋。直路中段無以為繼，末段再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W2W) Made some use take up a position outside the lead, failed to respond to riding in the home straight, weakened badly to finish tailed out. (Unacceptable Performance / No Vet findings.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W2W) 略受催策上前，佔取領放馬外側位置。直路上對催策毫無反應。末段嚴重轉弱，大敗而回。（表現難以接受。）（賽後接受獸醫檢查，並無發現任何明顯異常之處。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow(-) (1W1W3W5W) Jumped awkwardly, taken across to the fence racing at the rear 8Ls off the pace, switched away from inside midway, swung wide for home before running on well to take 2nd close home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速(-)(1W1W3W5W) 出閘笨拙，切入內欄，居後列，落後領放馬八個馬位。半程時移離內疊。入直路時移出外疊，其後以佳勢上前，接近終點時取得亞軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W4W) Gradually settled 3-wide with cover in last few, came under pressure from a similar position into straight, kept on steadily without quickening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W4W) 逐漸居最後數位之內，走第三疊，有遮擋。入直路時居相若位置，自該處起受催策。保持穩勢，但未能加速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow(-) (2W1W2W2W) Raced in rear, headway into mid-field middle stages, unable to secure clear run until 350m out, strong run final 200m to get up on line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速(-)(2W1W2W2W) 居後列。中段追前，進佔中間位置。未能望空直至三百五十米處。最後二百米走勢強勁，過終點時險勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W1W1W1W) Rail position in mid-field, had to wait for run turning into home straight, ran on well final 200m to close on leaders, attempted to savage rival close home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W1W1W1W) 沿欄居中間位置。轉入直路時須等待空位出現。最後二百米以佳勢上前，追近領先馬匹。接近終點時試圖噬咬對手。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W2W3W) Dropped out from widest draw, pushed along widest into home straight, unable to improve position.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W2W3W) 自大外檔出閘後墮後。入直路時受推策，走大外疊。末段未能追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W4W) Slightly slow out and bumped, raced behind midfield on the inside, 2 wide on turn, 4 lengths or so back turning in, unable to obtain clear run until approaching 100M, finished off evenly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W4W) 出閘稍慢及碰撞對手，居中間之後位置，走內疊。直路彎走第二疊。入直路時落後約四個馬位。未能望空直至趨近一百米處，末段以穩勢衝刺。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (2W2W2W1W) Keen towards rear, had to angle out for run 300m out, followed winner through, stayed on well.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(2W2W2W1W) 居後列，搶口。三百米處須向外移出取位。跟隨頭馬上前，末段保持佳勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow(+) (2W2W) In 4th place early stages, shuffled back to mid-division when pace slackened mid-race, quickened up sharply passing 400M then put the race to bed quickly winning by good margin.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速(+)(2W2W) 早段居第四位。賽事中段步速減慢時墮居中間位置。跑過四百米處時以勁勢加速，其後迅即控制大局，帶離餘駒取勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W3W) Settled in mid-field, travelled smoothly into home straight, briefly hampered 350m out, no extra final 100m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W3W) 居中間位置。入直路時走勢暢順。三百五十米處一度受阻礙。最後一百米再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Jumped only fairly, raced 2 wide behind midfield, 3 to 4 lengths back turning in, finished off evenly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 出閘僅屬一般，居中間之後位置，走第二疊。入直路時落後三至四個馬位。末段衝刺平穩。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W4W) Began only fairly, raced in midfield on the outside, 3 lengths or so back turning in, finished off well to take a place without threatening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W4W) 出閘僅屬一般，居中間位置，走外疊。入直路時落後約三個馬位。末段衝刺良佳，跑入季席，但未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W2W) Jumped only fairly, raced 2 wide better than midfield, there to turn, cleared 300M, finished off well to take 2nd, always held.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W2W) 出閘僅屬一般，居中間之前位置，走第二疊。直路彎前居相同位置。三百米處望空，末段衝刺良佳，跑獲亞軍，但一直落後。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow(-) (2W2W) Moderately away, raced 2 wide in midfield, 3 lengths back turning in, hard ridden after passing 300M, finished off very strongly to score.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速(-)(2W2W) 出閘普通，居中間位置，走第二疊。入直路時落後三個馬位。跑過三百米處後受力策。衝刺凌厲，掄元。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W3W) Slow to jump, sat towards rear on the inside, 4-1/2L back turning in, minor progress made in the Straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W3W) 出閘緩慢，居後列。走內疊。入直路時落後四個半馬位。直路上略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W2W1W) Awkward start and lost ground, raced in rear, keen middle stages, under pressure 550m out, outpaced and left behind in home straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W2W1W) 出閘笨拙及失地，居後列。中段搶口。五百五十米處受催策。直路上未能跟上步速及被拋離。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (2W2W5W5W) From wide draw dropped back to the rear 8Ls off the pace early stages, taken wider by rival 1000M before moving closer to midfield home turn, couldn't finish off as well as his rivals final 400M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(2W2W5W5W) 自外檔出閘，早段墮居後列，落後領放馬八個馬位。一千米處被對手帶出較外疊。直路彎追近至中間位置。最後四百米衝刺不及對手。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W2W) Jumped only fairly, raced behind midfield on the inside, 2 wide from 500M, finished off strongly, won by a head.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W2W) 出閘僅屬一般，居中間之後位置，走內疊。自五百米處起走第二疊，衝刺強勁，以一馬頭位之先勝出。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W3W) Jumped only fairly, raced towards rear on the outside, 6 lengths or so back in the middle stages, showed some response early in straight, no clear run near 200M, one-paced thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W3W) 出閘僅屬一般，居後列，走外疊。中段落後約六個馬位。直路早段對催策略有反應。接近二百米處時未能望空，其後保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W2W) Began only fairly and bumped, raced 2 wide towards rear, 5 lengths back, there to turn, made minor progress in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W2W) 出閘僅屬一般，被碰撞，居後列，落後五個馬位，走第二疊。直路彎前居相同位置。直路上略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (2W2W2W2W) Settled in mid-field, ridden top of home straight, gave ground final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(2W2W2W2W) 居中間位置。直路初受催策。最後二百米墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (4W3W2W4W) Waited with in rear, wide off final bend, one paced under pressure, never dangerous.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(4W3W2W4W) 居後列，留力候上。入直路時走外疊。末段在催策下保持同速。從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W3W) Tracked leader with the pace of the race very slow in middle stages, came under serious pressure 400M before dropping out of contention mid-straight. (Jockey - would derive benefit from its first run back from a spell today.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W3W) 跟隨領放馬，賽事中段步速非常緩慢。四百米處受力策，其後於直路中段再無爭勝機會。（騎師表示，休後復出的坐騎應能從是仗中提升狀態。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (2W1W1W2W) Moved forward tracking leaders, always in touch, couldn't accelerate when the race got serious 450M, kept on same pace to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(2W1W1W2W) 上前跟隨領先馬匹，一直居啣接位置。四百五十米處在關鍵時刻未能加速上前，只能保持同速至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Always thereabouts with rails run, taken some 2L back in 3rd 1200M out, commenced move on straightening and hit the front 300M out, soon drew clear.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 沿途居啣接位置，走內欄。千二米處留居第三位，落後約兩個馬位。入直路時開始發力，三百米處取得領先。瞬即帶離對手勝出。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W3W3W) Rail position in mid-field, switched 1200m out to make run 800m out, pushed along 600m out to chase leaders, lacked pace to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W3W3W) 居中間位置，走內欄。千二米處轉換跑線，八百米處取位上前。六百米處受推策追趕領先馬匹，但速度不足以展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W1W1W1W) From a wide draw taken back to last, 10Ls off the pace on settling, had big task in hand top of straight but failed to make real progress.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W1W1W1W) 自大外檔出閘後留居包尾位置，落後領放馬十個馬位。直路初仍落後甚遠。末段無甚進展。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W1W1W1W) Tracked leaders against rail, challenged and every chance from 300m out, stayed on well.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W1W1W1W) 沿欄跟隨領先馬匹。自三百米處起展開挑戰，一度甚具爭勝機會。其後保持佳勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W2W2W3W) Mid-field, unable to quicken over 300m out, weakened.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W2W2W3W) 居中間位置。三百米處未能加速，其後轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W2W) Jumped only fairly, settled in the second half of the field 6-7Ls off leaders, little change at the home turn, responded fairly in the straight and never troubled leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W2W) 出閘僅屬一般，居後半馬群中，落後領先馬匹六至七個馬位。直路彎居相若位置。直路上對催策反應一般。從未能對領先馬匹構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W3W3W3W) Jumped only fairly, settled near last in the early stages before moving to midfield halfway, 4Ls off leader top of straight but lacked a strong finishing effort.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W3W3W3W) 出閘僅屬一般。早段居接近包尾位置，半程時進佔中間位置。直路初落後領放馬四個馬位，但衝刺欠勁。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (1W1W1W1W) Slowly away settling in midfield mainly in 7th on rail, saved ground on the inside turning for home, ran on well under pressure to be nearest at finish.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(1W1W1W1W) 出閘緩慢，大多居中間第七位，走內欄。轉直路彎時走內欄節省腳程。在催策下以佳勢上前，過終點時最為接近。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (1W1W1W2W) Began only fairly, raced behind midfield on the inside, 2 wide from 350M, made good progress in straight to take 2nd without threatening the winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(1W1W1W2W) 出閘僅屬一般，居中間之後位置，走內疊。自三百五十米處起走第二疊。直路上追前甚多，跑獲亞軍，但未能威脅頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast(+) (1W1W1W1W) Given a waiting ride in a position towards the rear, had 7Ls to make up on leader leaving the bend, ran on well under pressure and swept past long time leader near line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速(+)(1W1W1W1W) 居後列，留力候上。跑離直路彎時仍落後領放馬七個馬位。在催策下以佳勢上前，接近終點時超越大部分途程帶頭的領放馬，掄元。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W1W1W1W) In rear after crowded at start, keen early stages, driven 400m out, ran on strongly final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W1W1W1W) 起步時受擠迫，其後居後列。早段搶口。四百米處受催策。最後二百米以勁勢追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W1W) Jumped well from gate 1, raced in midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, kept on same pace to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W1W) 自第一檔出閘迅速，居中間位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。保持同速至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W5W) Made contact at start, raced towards rear on the outside, 4 to 5 lengths back turning in, made good progress in straight to be nearest on line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W5W) 起步時被觸碰，居後列，走外疊。入直路時落後四至五個馬位。直路上追前頗多，過終點時最為接近。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W1W) Bumped start, raced behind midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, made no progress in straight. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W1W) 起步時發生碰撞，居中間之後位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路上毫無進展。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (2W2W2W3W) Sat behind midfield 2 wide, made no impression. (See Incident Report)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(2W2W2W3W) 居中間之後位置，走第二疊。毫無表現。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W1W1W2W) Impeded and forced to steady out of stalls, rail position in mid-field, angled out to make run 500m out, ran on well final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W1W1W2W) 出閘時受阻，被迫收慢，沿欄居中間位置。五百米處向外移出取位。最後二百米以佳勢追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W2W) Soon taken across from a wide barrier for an inside run, travelled tight in rear before making steady headway home bend, came to challenge under pressure upon straightening, ran on steadily without threatening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W2W) 自外檔出閘，瞬即切入內疊，居後列，緊迫競跑，直路彎穩步追前。入直路時在催策下上前挑戰。穩步上前，但未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast(+) (2W2W2W4W) Taken back from a wide draw, raced 2 wide towards rear, angled out approaching 500M, finished off strongly to take 2nd.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速(+)(2W2W2W4W) 自外檔出閘後留居後列，走第二疊。趨近五百米處時向外移出。以勁勢衝刺，跑獲亞軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Fast; (3W3W3W2W) Made forward move wide in back straight to race closer to pace, starting to find no extra when checked 100m out.
Jockey dropped whip.
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
快步速;(3W3W3W2W) 對面直路上開始上前，走外疊，追近領放馬。一百米處在勒避之際開始力竭。
跌掉馬鞭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow(+) (2W4W) Settled in front of midfield 2 wide, improved from the 700M, hit the front top of the Straight, keep on strongly to the line, won cozily.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速(+)(2W4W) 居中間之前位置，走第二疊。自七百米處起推進。直路初取得領先。保持勁勢至終點，從容獲勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W3W2W) Raced wide, forward move to go upsides leader 700m out, ridden to lead outright 400m out, kept going to repel challengers final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W3W2W) 走外疊。七百米處上前追迫領放馬。受催策，四百米處單騎領放。最後二百米保持走勢，力拒對手挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W2W2W3W) Settled in front of midfield 2 wide, under pressure from the 800M, took some time to respond, kept on okay.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W2W2W3W) 居中間之前位置，走第二疊。自八百米處起受催策，需時對催策作出反應。末段保持不俗走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (3W5W) From draw 12 crossed to a 3-wide spot in midfield without cover, travelled well leaving home turn and went for the lead, briefly in front near 100M before losing out in a close finish.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(3W5W) 自第十二檔出閘後切入，居中間位置，走第三疊，沒有遮擋。跑離直路彎時走勢良佳，上前爭奪領先。接近一百米處時一度領先，其後在與頭馬幾乎齊過終點下僅敗。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast(+) (2W2W2W2W3W2W) Settled in front of midfield, raced keenly in the early stages, commenced to improve rounding the Turn, closed off strongly (See Incident Report).
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速(+)(2W2W2W2W3W2W) 居中間之前位置。早段搶口。轉直路彎時開始推進。以勁勢衝刺。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W2W2W2W) Mid division, ridden along to hold position middle stages, hung in top of home straight, one paced under pressure.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W2W2W2W) 居中間位置。中段受催策以保持位置。直路初內閃。在催策下保持同速。

raceinfo_eng.RaceName: THE BOCHK PRIVATE BANKING JOCKEY CLUB SPRINT

raceinfo_chi.RaceName: 中銀香港私人銀行馬會短途錦標

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W2W) Led, always in touch, closed off strongly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W2W) 領放，沿途保持領先。末段衝刺強勁。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Average to begin, raced in 3rd, 1-1/2L back turning in, showed very good response in straight, took the lead approaching 200M, kept on very well to the line, easily scored.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 出閘一般，居第三位。轉入直路時落後一個半馬位。直路上對催策反應甚佳。趨近二百米處時取得領先。末段保持甚佳走勢。輕鬆取勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Tracked leader to straight, hit the front over 300M out and soon drew clear, won unchallenged.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 直路前跟隨領放馬。三百米處取得領先，瞬即拋離對手，在未受挑戰下勝出。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W2W) Tracked leader in a race run at fast tempo, cruised to the lead passing 400M, soon quickened away and left his rivals trailing. Won with tremendous ease posting a Hong Kong record 18th successive victory in course record time.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W2W) 跟隨領放馬，賽事步速甚快。跑過四百米處時上前取得領先。瞬即加速帶離對手。輕鬆取勝，締造十八連勝香港紀錄，並刷新場地紀錄時間。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Jumped on terms, sat just behind the leaders, responded well when asked, kicked clear at the 200M, won easing down.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 與對手同步出閘，居領先馬匹稍後位置。對催策反應良佳。二百米處加速帶離對手。在收慢下勝出。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W3W) Began well from gate 1, sent forward to take the lead, led by 1-3/4L turning in, kept on strongly in straight, won very easily.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W3W) 自第一檔出閘迅速，受催策上前領放。入直路時領先一又四分三個馬位。直路上保持強勁走勢，從容取勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Sat on pace, travelled strongly, hit the line nicely, easy win.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 跟隨領放馬。走勢強勁。衝刺良佳，從容取勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (2W2W) Settled towards rear in 7th over 3L off the pace, commenced move between runners upon straightening and ran on dourly under pressure to snatch victory final strides.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(2W2W) 居後列第七位，落後領放馬逾三個馬位。入直路時開始在馬匹之間上前。在催策下力拼，最後數步取得勝利。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Settled towards rear, traveled okay, made steady ground late.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;居後列，走勢尚可。末段以穩勢追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W1W) Just behind midfield early stages, gained closer to within 3L of pace in 6th rounding home bend, baulked for a run on rail the length of home straight, virtually not tested.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W1W) 早段居中間稍後位置。轉直路彎時追近至第六位，落後領放馬不逾三個馬位。直路上沿欄受困。從未能全力施為。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Held up last, still in last place top of home straight, good headway early in home straight, ran on strongly and beaten only narrowly,
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 留居包尾位置。直路初仍居包尾位置，以佳勢追前。末段走勢強勁，僅以短距離之差見負。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W2W) Taken back to race at rear on the inside, there to turn, finished off well to take a place without threatening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W2W) 留居後列，走內疊。直路彎前居相同位置。衝刺良佳，跑獲季軍，但未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W) Soon taken well back, over 7L off the pace rounding home bend, commenced move upon straightening running on steadily to reach distant 3rd late.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W) 瞬即留居遙遙落後的位置。轉直路彎時落後領放馬逾七個馬位。入直路時開始上前。穩步上前，末段進佔落後頗遠的第三位。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W2W) Jumped on terms, given a waiting ride towards the rear, ran on mildly from 400M and wasn't beaten far by the placegetters.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W2W) 與對手同步出閘，居後列，留力候上。自四百米處起保持普通走勢，負於亞軍及季軍馬匹不遠。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Sent forward to lead, kept on strongly to score.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 受催策上前領放。末段保持勁勢，掄元。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Sat rear, shifted in and obtained clear running near 400M, responded nicely when asked inside 200M (See Incident Report).
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;居後列。接近四百米處時向內移入，望空。二百米處對催策反應良佳。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W1W) From draw 1 obtained a midfield position along the inside, ran on steadily on straightening to finish 4th but was always held by leaders over final 200M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W1W) 自第一檔出閘，居中間位置，走內疊。入直路時穩步上前，取得第四名，但最後二百米一直落後領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; Pressed forward to be racing just off the leader, ran on well under pressure from 400M, briefly led inside 200M but not finishing as well as the first two late stages.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;受催策上前跟隨領放馬。自四百米處起受催策以佳勢上前，最後二百米一度領先，但末段衝刺不及前兩名馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(-) (1W1W1W) Tracked leaders against rail, had to wait for run turning into home straight, stuck to task.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(-)(1W1W1W) 跟隨領先馬匹，走內欄。轉入直路時須等待空位出現。末段持續力拼。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W1W) Settled within striking distance in 3rd on rail, tight for a run early in straight, gained upper hand 100M out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W1W) 居第三位，落後領放馬不遠，走內欄。直路早段緊迫競跑。一百米處佔得上風。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W1W) Showed good speed to lead, driven 300m out, headed by winner 200m out, stuck to task.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W1W) 展現甚快前速，取得領先。三百米處受催策。二百米處被頭馬超越。持續力拼。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W4W) Ridden from moderate start recovering to about 2L off the pace in 5th, dropped to 7th briefly upon straightening but ran on steadily inside final 400M to be nearest at finish.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W4W) 出閘普通，在催策下恢復走勢，居第五位，落後領放馬約兩個馬位。入直路時一度墮居第七位，但最後四百米穩步上前，過終點時最為接近。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Sat handy, raced in restricted room from 600M, ran on evenly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;居前列。自六百米處起在窄位競跑，走勢平穩。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (2W2W2W) Jumped on terms, settled in midfield but never too far behind leaders, switched into clear passing 200M before giving a strong kick to get up just in time.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(2W2W2W) 與對手同步躍出，居中間位置，但從未遠離領先馬匹。跑過二百米處時轉換跑線以望空，其後以勁勢加速，僅勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W3W) Inconvenienced at start from the widest barrier before gradually taken back for cover, obtained cover 2-wide in 9th onto first turn dropping to last into straight, produced good late impression under pressure final 200M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W3W) 自大外檔起步時受妨礙，其後逐漸留後以取得遮擋。開始轉直路彎時居第九位，走第二疊，有遮擋。入直路時墮居包尾位置。最後二百米在催策下追前甚多。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Bumped leaving stalls, dropped out from wide draw, pushed along widest into home straight, not beaten far.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 自外檔出閘時發生碰撞，墮後。入直路時受推策，走最外疊。所負不遠。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (3W2W) Slowly away, held up last, pushed along 500m out, still plenty to do top of home straight, ran on strongly final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(3W2W) 出閘緩慢，留居包尾位置。五百米處受推策。直路初仍落後頗遠。最後二百米以勁勢上前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W) Crowded at start, tracked leaders, travelled smoothly to chase leaders top of home straight, strong run to lead close home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W) 起步時受擠迫，跟隨領先馬匹。走勢暢順，直路初追趕領先馬匹。走勢強勁，接近終點時取得領先。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(-) (3W1W) Began fairly from a wide barrier, soon came to gain slender advantage 900M out, increased pace for 1L lead home bend and further clear into in straight only to be collared close to home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(-)(3W1W) 自外檔出閘一般。九百米處瞬即以短距離領先。直路彎加速，領先一個馬位。入直路時進一步帶離，僅於接近終點時被超越。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W1W) Waited with towards rear, still plenty to do top of home straight, challenged against rail from 200m out, ran on strongly to lead final 50m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W1W) 居後列，留力候上。直路初仍落後頗遠。自二百米處起沿欄展開挑戰。衝刺強勁，最後五十米取得領先。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W1W) Began smartly from a wide draw, sent forward to take the lead, led by a length turning in, kept on strongly in straight and won by 1-1/2L.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W1W) 自大外檔出閘迅速，受催策上前領放。入直路時領先一個馬位。直路上保持勁勢，以一個半馬位之先勝出賽事。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W) Bumped out of stalls, box seat, well placed into home straight, quickened early in home straight to lead 300m out, ran on strongly to kick two lengths clear 200m out, won going away.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W) 出閘時發生碰撞，居包廂位置。入直路時居好位。直路初加速，三百米處取得領先。走勢強勁，二百米處加速帶離對手兩個馬位，帶離勝出。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Began smartly from gate 13, raced in 2nd, 2 wide, there to turn, showed some response early in straight, peaked 250M, weakened final 150M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 自第十三檔出閘迅速，居第二位，走第二疊。直路彎前居相同位置。直路初對催策略有反應。二百五十米處未能再增速。最後一百五十米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Fast; (2W2W) Commenced well, raced in 3rd, a length or so back, there to turn, kept on well in straight to take a place without threatening. (See Racing Incidents.)
(Blood at the left nostril.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
快步速;(2W2W) 出閘迅速，居第三位，落後約一個馬位。直路彎前居相同位置。直路上保持佳勢，跑獲季軍，但未能構成威脅。（見競賽事件報告。）
（左邊鼻孔有血。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W2W) Fast away from the stalls and sat up on leader's girth, struck the lead when asked 300m out, but unable to hold off the strong-finishing challenger.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W2W) 出閘迅速，居領放馬外側。三百米處在催策下取得領先，但未能抗衡衝刺強勁的頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Jumped moderately settling just off the pace in 3rd or 4th on rail, saved ground turning in, ran home one-paced.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 出閘普通，緊隨領放馬，居第三或第四位，走內欄。入直路時走內疊節省腳程。末段保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W1W1W1W) Ridden along to lead, traveled fairly, weakened passing 100M (See Incident Report).
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W1W1W1W) 在催策下領放。走勢一般。跑過一百米處時轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W2W) Pressed forward from a poor draw, obtained one back 2-wide position 1100M out, in similar position but 3rd onto home bend, switched out to challenge 400M out, fought on dourly to get up final strides and just defy late challenges.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W2W) 自外檔出閘後受催策上前。千一米處居第二位，走第二疊。開始轉直路彎時居相若位置，但墮居第三位。四百米處向外移出以展開挑戰。末段力拼，最後數步取得領先，僅能力拒對手的挑戰，掄元。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W1W1W) Quickly into stride, up with early pace before sitting back to track leaders, run ended 250M then weakened rapidly to finish last.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W1W1W) 展步迅速，早段跟上步速，其後留後，跟隨領先馬匹。二百五十米處無以為繼，其後迅速轉弱，包尾而回。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; Jumped awkwardly, raced in midfield but never far off from leaders, stayed on reasonably well final 300M. Not beaten far.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;出閘笨拙，居中間位置，但從未遠離領先馬匹。最後三百米保持頗佳走勢，所負不遠。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W1W) Driven forward form draw 10 to take up running, shook off rivals early straight to open up 2.5L lead mid-straight, caught by winner close home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W1W) 自第十檔出閘後受催策上前領放。直路早段擺脫對手，直路中段帶離兩個半馬位。接近終點時被頭馬超越。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W1W1W1W) Shifted in at start, positioned 2 lengths behind the leader on rail, saved ground throughout, challenged the leaders early in straight, peaked 150M, weakened final 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W1W1W1W) 起步時向內斜跑，落後領放馬兩個馬位，走內欄。沿途走內欄節省腳程。直路初挑戰領先馬匹。一百五十米處未能再增速。最後一百米轉弱。

raceinfo_eng.RaceName: THE BOCHK PRIVATE WEALTH JOCKEY CLUB MILE

raceinfo_chi.RaceName: 中銀香港私人財富馬會一哩錦標

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (2W4W) Restrained to race in second half of the field, swung wide for home before running on moderately to claim 3rd without threatening the winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(2W4W) 受約束，居後半馬群中。入直路時移出外疊，其後走勢普通，跑獲季軍，未能威脅頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast(+) (1W3W) Settled in last few from a poor draw and waited with, shifted off rail for a run entering home straight, quickened well inside final 300M to hit the front 150M out, hung on well under pressure.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速(+)(1W3W) 自外檔出閘，居最後數位之內，留力候上。入直路時移離內欄取位。最後三百米以佳勢加速。一百五十米處取得領先。在催策下保持佳勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow(-) (1W2W) Shifted out and bumped out of stalls, rail position in rear of mid-field, driven 350m out, strong run to challenge winner, just failed.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速(-)(1W2W) 出閘時向外斜跑及與對手互相碰撞，居中間之後位置，走內欄。三百五十米處受催策。以勁勢上前挑戰頭馬，僅敗。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W1W1W3W) Settled at the back of the small field travelling some 10L off the speed, ran on to reach remote 3rd briefly about 100M out but headed for the placing late.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W1W1W3W) 在六駒中居後列，落後領放馬約十個馬位。末段上前，約一百米處一度進佔落後頗遠的第三位，但末段被超越，失去位置。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast(-) (2W3W) Chased leader early, drifted back after being steadied 800M, had difficulty obtaining clear running 350-250M before running on mildly to the line to share 4th spot.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速(-)(2W3W) 早段追趕領放馬。八百米處收慢後墮退。三百五十米處至二百五十米處之間難以望空。末段走勢普通，取得平頭第四名。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W5W) Settled in forward of midfield, drifted slightly backward to rear of midfield when pace quickened onto home bend, shifted wide for a run but slightly inconvenienced upon straightening, fought on steadily without threatening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W5W) 居中間之前位置。開始轉直路彎賽事步速加快時略為墮居中間之後位置。入直路時移出外疊取位，但略受妨礙。持續力拼，未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W3W) Jumped fairly, gradually improved to within 2L of pace in joint 3rd 2-wide, hit the front over 200M out only to be swamped inside final 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W3W) 出閘一般。逐漸上前，並居第三位，落後領放馬不逾兩個馬位，走第二疊。二百米處取得領先，僅於最後一百米被超越。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W3W) Dropped back to a position near the rear, 6Ls to make up 400M, chased steadily without threatening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W3W) 墮居接近後列位置。四百米處落後六個馬位。持續追前，但未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Settled towards the rear, 5Ls to make up passing 400M but lacked a kick in the straight. (Jockey satisfied with the finishing effort in the straight / No Vet findings.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 居後列。跑過四百米處時落後五個馬位，但直路上未能加速。（騎師滿意坐騎在直路上的衝刺。賽後接受獸醫檢查，並無發現任何明顯異常之處。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W4W) Out in line, taken back to race at rear on the outside, 4-1/2L back turning in, made no impression in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W4W) 與對手同步出閘，留居後列，走外疊。轉入直路時落後四個半馬位。直路上毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Settled in rear over 7L off the pace, baulked until inside the 200M out, quickened well to reach distant 2nd 60M out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 居後列，落後領放馬逾七個馬位。受困直至二百米處。末段加速良佳，六十米處進佔落後頗遠的第二位。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W2W) Jumped well and reserved in midfield, battled on well to take 2nd near 150M but once again proved no match for champion KA YING RISING.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W2W) 出閘迅速，留居中間位置。以佳勢力拼，接近一百五十米處時進佔第二位，但再次不敵香港馬王「嘉應高昇」。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W2W) Sat midfield on the rail, closed off nicely, just no threat to winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W2W) 居中間位置，走內欄。末段衝刺良佳，但未能威脅頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W6W) Made contact at start, raced 2 wide in midfield, 3 wide approaching 600M, carried wider turning in, kept on evenly in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W6W) 起步時發生觸碰，居中間位置，走第二疊。趨近六百米處時走第三疊。入直路時被帶出更外疊。直路上保持穩勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W2W) Jumped awkwardly and settled last, had the job ahead 400M, came from a long way back to charge home under top weight and just missed.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W2W) 出閘笨拙，居包尾位置。四百米處落後頗遠。負頂磅下末段自遙遙落後的位置追前，僅敗。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast(+) (1W2W) Settled at the back and waited with, commenced move entering home straight obtaining a clear run over 200M out, responded well under pressure but the post came too soon.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速(+)(1W2W) 居包尾位置，留力候上。入直路時開始上前。二百米處望空。末段對催策反應良佳，但為時已晚。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W1W) Moderate start, settled at the back, produced good late impression in home straight, never nearer.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W1W) 出閘普通，居後列。直路上追前頗多。以末段最為接近。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (3W4W) Three wide in rear of mid-field, headway halfway out, wide into home straight, stayed on for pressure.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(3W4W) 居中間之後位置，走第三疊。半程時上前。入直路時走外疊。末段在催策下保持走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W) Not hurried early and middle stages, raced at the rear 6Ls off the fast pace, made some progress final 400M and just missed out on 3rd place. Soundly beaten by the winner KA YING RISING.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W) 早段及中段未受催策，居後列，落後步速甚快的領放馬六個馬位。最後四百米略為追前，僅失季軍。在頭馬「嘉應高昇」之後所負頗遠。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W2W) In midfield, raced keenly early and middle stages, drifted back to the rear after being checked 800M, ran home fairly final 400M. No impression on leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W2W) 居中間位置。早段及中段搶口。八百米處勒避。其後墮居後列。最後四百米走勢一般。未能威脅領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (3W7W) Travelled 3-wide in last few, shifted widest for a run into straight, ran on quite well but unable to sustain effort inside final 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(3W7W) 居最後數位之內，走第三疊。入直路時移出最外疊取位。走勢頗佳，但最後一百米無以為繼。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W) Broke well to lead early, ceded advantage on rail passing the 1000M to be one back in 3rd, renewed effort 600M out gaining to 2nd but unable to sustain effort and swamped inside final 150M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W) 出閘迅速，早段取得領先。跑過一千米處靠近內欄競跑時被超越，落後一個馬位，居第三位。六百米處重新發力，進佔第二位，但無以為繼。最後一百五十米被超越。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Led steadily, came under siege early straight, battled on well to hold his leader spot before gave way grudgingly to first 3 final stages.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 以平穩步速領放。直路初受挑戰。以佳勢力拼，保持領先，末段被三甲馬匹超越。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(-) (2W1W) Chased the leader, traveled nicely, had every chance.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(-)(2W1W) 追趕領放馬，走勢良佳。已獲機會盡展所長。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W1W) Ridden early to share the pace, obtained outright lead on rail 1000M out and led until headed inside the 400M, soon faded in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W1W) 早段受催策，並排領先。一千米處沿欄單騎領放。四百米處被超越。直路上瞬即力竭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W) Vied for lead early crossing to rail in front just inside the 1100M, kicked 2L clear briefly rounding home bend before joined into straight and eventually headed inside the 200M. (Riding in home straight questioned.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W) 早段爭奪領先，跑過千一米處後切入內欄領放。轉直路彎時加速，一度帶離兩個馬位。入直路時被追上，二百米處被超越。（騎師被查詢在直路上的騎法。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W1W) Soon took up running from a poor draw, set a fast tempo after obtaining rails run 1200M out, led the field until overhauled inside final 200M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W1W) 自外檔出閘瞬即取得領先。千二米處移入內欄後以快步速領放。保持領先直至最後二百米被後上馬匹超越。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W) Quickly into stride, led and set fast pace to the straight, headed passing 400M, held 2nd to about 150M, no extra close home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W) 展步迅速，取得領先。直路前以甚快步速領放。跑過四百米處時被超越。保持居第二位直至約一百五十米處。接近終點時再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (3W5W) Raced in second half of the field and caught wide no cover throughout, failed to run on under top weight in the final straight. (No Vet findings.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(3W5W) 居後半馬群中，沿途走外疊，沒有遮擋。直路上在負頂磅下未能追前。（賽後接受獸醫檢查，並無發現任何明顯異常之處。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W) Restrained from the wide barrier in the early stages and settled towards the rear, had some work to do 400M, ran on well enough but couldn't quite get there.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W) 自外檔出閘，於早段受約束，居後列。四百米處落後頗遠。走勢良佳，但未能追上頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Settled down in mid-division 6Ls off leader, travelled well turning for home, had to shift to outside for clear running mid-straight before getting home strongly to lead near line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 居中間位置，落後領放馬六個馬位。轉直路彎時走勢良佳。直路中段須移出外疊以望空。末段衝刺強勁，接近終點時取得領先。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow(-) (1W2W) Rail position in mid-field, keen 750m out, under pressure 500m out, ran on strongly to lead 150m out, on top from there.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速(-)(1W2W) 居中間位置，走內欄。七百五十米處搶口。五百米處受催策。走勢強勁，一百五十米處取得領先。其後保持領先。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow(-) (1W1W) Taken well back from the widest barrier and waited with, commenced move on rail home bend saving ground for 2.5L 7th into straight, obtained clear run back on rail 200M out, ran on dourly under pressure to just fail.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速(-)(1W1W) 自大外檔出閘後遙居後列，留力候上。直路彎開始發力，走內欄以省腳程。入直路時居第七位，落後兩個半馬位。二百米處移回內欄望空。在催策下持續力拼，僅敗。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W5W) Not hurried and settled near last in early and middle stages, brought wide for home before staying on well to take 5th on testing ground.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W5W) 早段及中段未受催策，居接近包尾位置。入直路時移出外疊。其後保持佳勢，跑軟地取得第五名。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (3W3W) Tracked pace out wide without cover, struggled to hold position from 500m out, gave ground final 300m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(3W3W) 跟隨領放馬，走外疊，沒有遮擋。自五百米處起難以保持位置。最後三百米墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(-) (1W1W) Jumped on terms, kicked up to lead by 1L on settling, headed by winner near 200M, gave everything but got tired late stages. Held on for 2nd spot just.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(-)(1W1W) 與對手同步躍出，加速領先一個馬位。接近二百米處時被頭馬超越。全力以赴，但末段呈疲態。僅保住亞軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Taken back from a wide draw and raced near last, 5Ls off leader home turn, worked home steadily from 400M but was never a serious threat.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 自最外檔出閘，留居接近包尾位置。直路彎落後領放馬五個馬位。自四百米處起衝刺平穩，但從未能構成真正威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W1W) Soon recovered along the rail from a slow start, over 2L back in 5th before gaining slightly closer to pace into home straight, tightened when beaten inside the 200M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W1W) 起步緩慢，瞬即恢復走勢，居第五位，落後逾兩個馬位，走內欄。入直路時略為追近領放馬。二百米處在受緊迫之際洩氣。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W3W) Sluggish start, raced in touch with leaders, taken wider 700m out, bumped 250m out, unable to recover.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W3W) 出閘緩慢，緊隨領先馬匹。七百米處移出較外疊。二百五十米處被碰撞，未能恢復走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Taken back from a wide draw, raced 2 wide at rear, found rail 700M, 4 to 5 lengths back turning in, made some headway in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 自外檔出閘後留後，居後列，走第二疊。七百米處移入內欄。入直路時落後四至五個馬位。直路上略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W2W) In midfield early before moving closer to leaders from 1000M, caught racing wide no cover to the straight, run ended 300M and dropped out from contention.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W2W) 早段居中間位置。自一千米處起追近領先馬匹。直路前走外疊，沒有遮擋。三百米處無以為繼。其後墮退，再無爭勝機會。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W) Settled midfield, traveled nicely, made good ground when asked.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W) 居中間位置，走勢良佳。在催策下追前甚多。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W) From draw 2 pushed along to take up a midfield spot, travelled well into straight and quickened up to hit the front near the 200m. Won going away.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W) 自第二檔出閘，受推策上前佔取中間位置。入直路時走勢良佳，加速，接近二百米處時取得領先。帶離勝出。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow(-) (2W3W) Settled in mid-field, had to wait for run turning into home straight, ridden along 300m out, ran on well to close on winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速(-)(2W3W) 居中間位置。轉入直路時須等待空位出現。三百米處受催策。以佳勢上前，追近頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W) Ridden to muster early pace before settling some 2L back in 3rd or 4th on rail, further off the pace when tempo increased home bend, commenced move into straight, ran on under pressure to just prevail inside the 150M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W) 早段在催策下加速，其後居第三或第四位，落後約兩個馬位，走內欄。直路彎步速加快時落後領放馬更遠。入直路時開始發力。最後一百五十米在催策下上前，僅勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W2W) Held up last, still in last pair top of home straight, short of room final 100m, unable to be ridden out to finish.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W2W) 留居包尾位置。直路初仍居最後兩位之內。最後一百米空位不足，未能被力策至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W3W) Began only fairly and bumped, raced 2 wide at rear, there to turn, made good progress in straight to make frame, no threat to the first few.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W3W) 出閘僅屬一般及被碰撞，居後列，走第二疊。直路彎前居相同位置。直路上追前甚多，取得第四名，但未能威脅三甲馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W5W) Jumped only fairly, raced at tail, 5 to 6 lengths back turning in, passed some tired runners in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W5W) 出閘僅屬一般，居包尾位置。入直路時落後五至六個馬位。直路上超越一些已呈疲態的對手。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W3W) Sat rear, switched out rounding the Turn, made steady progress late.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W3W) 居後列。轉直路彎時向外移出。末段穩步上前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Niggled along to obtain a handy spot behind leaders, moved up to challenge 350M, reached the forefront 150M but had no extra to offer final stages.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 受催策佔取領先馬匹之後的有利位置。三百五十米處上前展開挑戰。一百五十米處進佔前列，但末段再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast(+) (2W3W) Settled in rear of midfield, came to challenge inside the 400M and ran on well under pressure to assert authority 100M out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速(+)(2W3W) 居中間之後位置。四百米處上前展開挑戰。其後在催策下以佳勢追前，一百米處控制大局。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W1W) Settled in midfield in 7th some 4L off the pace, saved ground turning in for home but baulked for a run in straight until inside the 250M and again when forced to switch out just inside the 100M, made no further impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W1W) 居中間第七位，落後領放馬約四個馬位。轉入直路時走內疊節省腳程。直路上受困直至二百五十米處。跑過一百米處後被迫向外移出之際再次受困。末段再無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (3W3W3W5W) Held up wide in last few racing keenly early stages, commenced move in wider into home straight, only produced moderate impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(3W3W3W5W) 早段留居最後數位之內，走外疊，搶口。入直路時開始上前，走更外疊。表現僅屬一般。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W3W) Awkward start and lost ground, rail position in rear of mid-field, briefly tight for room early in home straight, made up some late ground.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W3W) 出閘笨拙及失地，居中間之後位置，走內欄。直路早段一度受緊迫。末段略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast(+) (2W2W) Reserved behind midfield 4-5Ls off the pace, held up for clear running from 400M-200M before coming through strongly to win by 2L at the end. Extraordinarily performance.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速(+)(2W2W) 留居中間位置，落後領放馬四至五個馬位。四百米處至二百米處之間受困而未能望空。其後以勁勢穿插上前，過終點時以兩個馬位之先勝出。表現出色。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast(+) (1W3W) Jumped only fairly, settled down nicely in midfield, switched away from fence 700M, quickened up well early straight to lead inside 300M, kept going strongly for an impressive win.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速(+)(1W3W) 出閘僅屬一般，居中間位置，走勢良佳。七百米處移離內欄。直路早段以佳勢加速，三百米處取得領先，保持勁勢，勝出賽事，表現出色。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W3W) Settled midfield about 4Ls off leader, was bustled along 500M but lacked a change of gears in the run to the line. (Jockey could offer no excuse for the disappointing performance / No Vet findings.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W3W) 居中間位置，落後領放馬約四個馬位。五百米處受催策，但末段未能加速。（騎師未能就坐騎令人失望的表現提供任何解釋。賽後接受獸醫檢查，並無發現任何明顯異常之處。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Restrained in mid-division, had about 4Ls to make up 400M, made up good ground in the run home and ran the winner close late.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 受約束居中間位置，四百米處落後約四個馬位。末段追前頗多，緊隨頭馬衝線。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Fast; (1W1W) Slow to begin, recovered to race behind midfield, came under pressure home turn, couldn't go on passing 250M and soon left behind by leaders.
(Bled.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
快步速;(1W1W) 出閘緩慢，其後恢復走勢，居中間之後位置。直路彎受催策。跑過二百五十米處時未能追前，瞬即被領先馬匹拋離。
（流鼻血。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast(+) (2W2W2W3W) Settled well behind and waited with, obtained a clear run upon straightening 400M out, finished off the race strongly down the centre of track.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速(+)(2W2W2W3W) 遙居於後，留力候上。四百米處入直路時望空。在跑道中央以勁勢衝刺。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast(+) (2W5W) Dropped out from wide draw, pushed along wide into home straight, strong run to lead 150m out, on top from there.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速(+)(2W5W) 自外檔出閘後墮後。入直路時受推策，走外疊。走勢強勁，一百五十米處取得領先。其後保持領先。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow(-) (3W5W) Taken back from the widest draw, raced at tail, 6 to 7 lengths back turning in, very wide into straight, finished off very strongly to score.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速(-)(3W5W) 自最外檔出閘後留居包尾位置。入直路時落後六至七個馬位，走大外疊。末段衝刺凌厲，掄元。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W5W) Raced in touch with leaders out wide, tended to hang out on bend, pushed ahead over 200m out, weakened final 100m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W5W) 跟隨領先馬匹，走外疊。直路彎傾向外閃。二百米處受推策上前。最後一百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W2W) From wide draw managed to slot in behind leaders, struggled to go with them turning home, weakened to last. (Jockey - did not appreciate carrying top weight of 135 lbs and being first up today .)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W2W) 自最外檔出閘，成功切入居領先馬匹之後。轉直路彎時掙扎上前，其後轉弱，包尾而回。（騎師表示，坐騎未能適應負頂磅一百三十五磅上陣，加上是今季首次出賽。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (3W4W) Prominent very wide after beginning from a poor draw, remained 3-wide without cover in 5th over 2L back to home straight, ran on to hold every chance until the 200M when found no extra.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(3W4W) 自外檔出閘，居前列，走大外疊。直路前保持居第五位，落後逾兩個馬位，走第三疊，沒有遮擋。上前，一度極具爭勝機會直至二百米處，其後再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W3W) Rail position in mid-field, angled out to make run 700m out, stayed on well in home straight for clear third.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W3W) 居中間位置，走內欄。七百米處向外移出取位。直路上保持佳勢，在帶離餘駒下取得季軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (4W1W1W3W) Prominent and wide early from the widest draw of the small field, eventually settled in 4th onto first bend, over 6L off the speed in back straight and unable to make any impression in the critical stages.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(4W1W1W3W) 自最外檔出閘，早段在六駒中居前列，走外疊。開始轉首個彎位時居第四位。對面直路上落後領放馬逾六個馬位，末段毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast(-) (3W3W) Jumped awkwardly, chased leaders in a 3-wide spot without cover, couldn't go with first two passing 300M, battled on late stages to hold 3rd.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速(-)(3W3W) 出閘笨拙，追趕領先馬匹，走第三疊，沒有遮擋。跑過三百米處時未能跟隨頭兩名馬匹上前。末段在力拼下保住季軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W3W) Broke well from a poor draw, settled one off the lead and gradually shifted across for 3-wide position over 1100M out, came to challenge upon straightening and gained upper hand 50M out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W3W) 自外檔出閘迅速，落後領放馬一個馬位。千一米處逐漸切入第三疊。入直路時展開挑戰。五十米處佔得上風。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (2W1W1W1W) Ended up leading, set very slow pace in early and middle stages, quickened up tempo 600M, couldn't hold off winner 300M, kept on to hold 2nd comfortably.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(2W1W1W1W) 取得領先，早段及中段以非常緩慢步速領放。六百米處加快步速，三百米處未能抗衡頭馬。末段保持走勢，穩奪亞軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W2W) On jumping became unbalanced, moved up to track leader on outside, vied for lead from 500M before giving way to pursuing rivals mid-straight. (No Vet findings.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W2W) 躍出時失去平衡，上前跟隨領放馬，走外疊。自五百米處起爭奪領先，其後於直路中段被緊追的對手超越。（賽後接受獸醫檢查，並無發現任何明顯異常之處。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (2W2W2W2W) Raced keenly just off the pace, moved up to vie for lead from 800M, hard driven to gain narrow lead mid-straight, dug deep but couldn't hold off ROMANTIC WARRIOR in final stages.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(2W2W2W2W) 居領放馬稍後位置，搶口。上前，自八百米處起爭奪領先。受力策，直路中段領先短距離。力拼，但末段未能抗衡「浪漫勇士」。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W1W1W1W) Made running, joined by rivals top of home straight, headed by winner 300m out, gave ground final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W1W1W1W) 領放。直路初被對手追及。三百米處被頭馬超越。最後二百米墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W1W1W1W) Pressed forward from a poor draw to soon take up running on rail attempting to make all in a smart pace, led the field until finding no extra 200M out, hung on well for second.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W1W1W1W) 自外檔出閘，受催策上前，瞬即沿欄領放，嘗試以快步速一放到底。保持領先直至二百米處後勁不繼，但仍能保持佳勢跑獲亞軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W1W) Across to press leader, improved to lead 1000m out, ridden 400m out, headed by winner 150m out, sticking to task.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W1W) 切入追迫領放馬。上前，一千米處取得領先。四百米處受催策。一百五十米處被頭馬超越。其後持續力拼。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W1W) Soon led, pressed by rival middle stages setting a fast pace to the straight, kept going well passing 400M, found extra mid-straight to beat off his nearest rival, went clear late stages. Impressive.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W1W) 瞬即領放。中段被對手追迫。直路前以快步速領放。跑過四百米處時保持佳勢。直路中段加速，力拒第二位馬匹的挑戰，末段帶離對手，贏得漂亮。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W1W1W1W) Ridden along to lead, traveled smoothly, led all the way to score.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W1W1W1W) 在催策下取得領先，走勢暢順。一放到底掄元。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Very fast(+) (1W2W) Began fairly, recovered steadily to rear of midfield in 9th some 6L off the pace, shifted out for a run approaching home turn but baulked early in straight, obtained clear passage 300M out and ran on without threatening.
(Lost left front plate.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
極快步速(+)(1W2W) 出閘僅屬一般，逐漸恢復走勢，居中間之後第九位，落後領放馬約六個馬位。趨近直路彎時向外移出取位，但直路初受困。三百米處望空。保持走勢，未能構成威脅。
（失去左前蹄的蹄鐵。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Very fast; (2W3W) Always prominent racing keenly at times in early stages, drifted over 2L back to 5th coming onto home bend, fought on steadily under pressure in straight but never able to peg back the place-getters.
(Lost left hind plate.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
極快步速;(2W3W) 早段一直居前列，時而搶口。開始轉直路彎時墮居第五位，落後逾兩個馬位。直路上在催策下持續力拼，但從未能追上三甲馬匹。
（失去左後蹄的蹄鐵。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W2W) Settled in rear of midfield some 4L off the pace on rail, gained closer while pace slackened around home bend, baulked and switched in for a run over 350M out, one paced in the run to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W2W) 居中間之後位置，落後領放馬約四個馬位，走內欄。轉直路彎步速減慢時追近。其後受困，三百五十米處向內移入取位。末段保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W1W) Sat in behind the leaders 2L on settling, still in touch turning for home but failed to get going, no threat from mid-straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W1W) 居領先馬匹之後，落後兩個馬位。入直路時仍居啣接位置，但未能加速。自直路中段起未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W2W) Dropped out from widest draw, held up last, still in last place top of home straight, never involved.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W2W) 自最外檔出閘後墮後，留居包尾位置。直路初仍居包尾位置。從未參與競逐。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(-) (1W1W1W2W) Broke well from the one draw settling in 2nd chasing within 2L of the pace, came to challenge making final turn drawing level early in home straight, but no match to winner's burst of speed 300M out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(-)(1W1W1W2W) 自第一檔出閘迅速，居第二位，追趕至落後領放馬不足兩個馬位。轉直路彎時展開挑戰。直路初並排領先，但三百米處未能與頭馬的加速力抗衡。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W2W) Caught wide early stages, improved to race outside leader, failed to pick up early straight and looked beaten, made up some ground late however and not beaten far by the placegetters at the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W2W) 早段走外疊，其後推進至領放馬外側。直路初未能加速，看似洩氣，但末段略為追前，終點線上負於入位馬匹不遠。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W1W1W) Crowded at start, gradually settled in 5th on rail some 4L back, closer to lead when tempo slackened in back straight, came under pressure home bend and saved ground turning in, found no extra final 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W1W1W) 起步時受擠迫，逐漸居第五位，落後約四個馬位，走內欄。對面直路上在步速減慢下追近領放馬。直路彎受催策，入直路時走內疊節省腳程。最後一百米再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W1W1W2W) Tracked pace, shuffled back to mid-field 700m out, ridden and left behind final 400m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W1W1W2W) 跟隨領放馬。七百米處墮居中間位置。最後四百米受催策，但被拋離。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (3W2W2W3W) Settled in mid-division 3-4Ls off leader in a slowly run race, little change in position to the straight, kept on fairly to the line. Never dangerous.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(3W2W2W3W) 居中間位置，落後領放馬三至四個馬位，賽事步速緩慢。直路前位置大致不變。末段保持一般走勢，從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W3W) Began only fairly and wasn't far off leaders early stages, shuffled back to midfield 800M, hard driven from 500M but couldn't make any headway.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W3W) 出閘僅屬一般，早段落後領先馬匹不遠。八百米處墮居中間位置。自五百米處起受力策，但未能追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W4W) Waited with towards rear, pushed along wide into home straight, lacked pace to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W4W) 居後列，留力候上。入直路時受推策，走外疊。速度不足以展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W2W2W2W) From a middle draw obtained running in midfield 3-4Ls off the fast pace, had no clear running early straight, crowded near 200M and didn't run on thereafter. (No Vet findings.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W2W2W2W) 自第六檔出閘，居中間位置，在快步速下落後三至四個馬位。直路早段未能望空。接近二百米處時受擠迫，其後未能上前。（賽後接受獸醫檢查，並無發現任何明顯異常之處。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (2W2W) Pressed leader, quickened early in home straight to lead 300m out, headed by winner 150m out, sticking to task.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(2W2W) 追迫領放馬。直路初加速，三百米處取得領先。一百五十米處被頭馬超越。持續力拼。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow(+) (1W1W1W1W) Set slow pace first half of the race, was taken on by rival from 800M, battled hard on straightening, lost lead nearing 200M and weakened late stages. Held on for 4th just.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速(+)(1W1W1W1W) 賽事前半程以慢步速領放。自八百米處起受對手挑戰。入直路時力拼。接近二百米處時失去領先位置。末段轉弱，僅能保住第四名。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W1W1W1W) Not the quickest out, ridden along to lead, travelled comfortably, kept on well to score.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W1W1W1W) 出閘並非最快，受催策，取得領先。走勢暢順。末段保持佳勢，掄元。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (5W4W3W3W) Tracked pace out wide without cover, pushed along 600m out to chase leaders, stayed on steadily.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(5W4W3W3W) 跟隨領放馬，走外疊，沒有遮擋。六百米處受推策，追趕領先馬匹。保持穩勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W2W) Given a waiting ride, in the last spot entering the turn, had a few ahead as they headed for home and the final effort was just fair. Never in the picture.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W2W) 留力候上。進入直路彎時居包尾位置。末段仍居多駒之後，衝刺僅屬一般。從未參與競逐。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W1W1W2W) Given a waiting ride 8L towards the rear of the field, pressed along 550M, stayed on mildly in the run home for 5th without threatening first three.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W1W1W2W) 居後列，留力候上，落後八個馬位。五百五十米處受催策。末段保持一般走勢，取得第五名，未能威脅頭三名馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (2W2W2W4W) Sat at the rear, stayed on nicely until 200M, one pace thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(2W2W2W4W) 居後列。保持佳勢直至二百米處，其後保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W4W) Driven along and outpaced early stages, pushed along widest into home straight, ran on well early in home straight, no extra final 50m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W4W) 早段受催策，未能跟上步速。入直路時受推策，走最外疊。直路初以佳勢上前。最後五十米再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W1W1W3W) Soon dropped to the rear in 5th, came under pressure after turning in for home, fought on dourly to claim 3rd 100M out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W1W1W3W) 瞬即墮退至後列第五位。轉入直路後受催策。持續力拼，一百米處進佔季席。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W1W1W1W) Jumped well, sat in front of midfield, lay in near the 200M, (See Incident Report).
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W1W1W1W) 出閘迅速，居中間之前位置。接近二百米處時內閃。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W4W3W4W) Taken well back, made rapid progress around the field from 1100M out reaching 3rd one back about 800M out, remained 3-wide without cover bend, kept on under pressure in straight and swamped for a placing inside final 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W4W3W4W) 遙居於後。自千一米處起繞過馬群快速上前，八百米處進佔第三位，落後一個馬位。直路彎走第三疊，沒有遮擋。直路上在催策下保持走勢。最後一百米被超越，失去一席位置。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (2W2W1W4W) Held up, under pressure and outpaced 600m out, still in rear 200m out, finished strongly and passed several rivals final 100m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(2W2W1W4W) 留後。六百米處受催策，未能跟上步速。二百米處仍居後列。末段衝刺強勁，最後一百米超越數匹對手。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W1W1W1W) From draw 1 settled in midfield along the fence, under pressure long way from home and was pretty weak in the straight. (Jockey - did not travel throughout on its first race start at the Valley.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W1W1W1W) 自第一檔出閘，居中間位置，沿欄競跑。離終點尚遠時已受催策，直路上走勢頗弱。（騎師表示，首次在跑馬地上陣的坐騎沿途走勢欠順。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (2W3W) Tracked leaders, switched to make run 600m out, stayed on under pressure, tight for room close home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(2W3W) 跟隨領先馬匹。六百米處轉換跑線推進。在催策下保持走勢。接近終點時受緊迫。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (2W2W1W3W) Dropped back to race at the back of the field 10Ls off leader on settling, made limited progress on straightening and was never in the picture.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(2W2W1W3W) 留居後列，落後領放馬十個馬位。入直路時略為追前，從未有力一爭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (2W4W) Settled in rear of mid-field, ridden 600m out, ran on well final 200m but no match for winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(2W4W) 居中間之後位置。六百米處受催策。最後二百米以佳勢上前，但不敵頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast(+) (2W3W) Settled just worse than midfield in 6th or 7th, came to challenge under pressure upon straightening, ran on steadily to snatch 3rd late.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速(+)(2W3W) 居中間稍後第六或第七位。入直路時在催策下上前挑戰。末段穩步上前，跑獲季軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (4W3W3W4W) Sat midfield, minor progress under whip.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(4W3W3W4W) 居中間位置。在鞭策下略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Slow; (2W3W) Settled in midfield early stages before making a forward move 800M, led nearing 300M, kept going well only to be caught by winner final stages.
sustained a small abrasion to the left hind leg.
runnerrecords.healthissue_eng: sustained a small abrasion to the left hind leg.
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
慢步速;(2W3W) 早段居中間位置。其後在八百米處發力上前。接近三百米處時取得領先。末段保持佳勢，僅被頭馬超越。
左後腿輕微擦傷。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow(-) (2W2W3W3W) Sat last early, made a forward move from the 800M, kept on fairly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速(-)(2W2W3W3W) 早段居包尾位置。自八百米處起上前。保持一般走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (3W4W) Mid division, switched wide 900m out, pushed along wide into home straight, outpaced.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(3W4W) 居中間位置。九百米處移出外疊。入直路時受推策，走外疊。未能跟上步速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (2W2W2W3W) Raced in second half of the field 7Ls off leader, under pressure to keep up rounding home turn, failed to get involved in the finish.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(2W2W2W3W) 居後半馬群中，落後領放馬七個馬位。轉直路彎時受催策以跟上。末段未能參與競逐。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W1W1W1W) Sat just behind the leaders, showed good dash top of the Straight, run peaked at 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W1W1W1W) 居領先馬匹稍後位置。直路初加速良佳。一百米處未能再增速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (2W3W) Waited with in rear, pushed along wide into home straight, stayed on well and passed plenty of fields.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(2W3W) 居後列，留力候上。入直路時受推策，走外疊。末段保持佳勢，超越多駒。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast(+) (2W2W2W4W) Away well, raced 2 wide behind midfield, a bit closer on turn, commenced move after passing 550M, showed very good response in straight, hit the front 150M, kept on well to the line and scored.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速(+)(2W2W2W4W) 出閘迅速，居中間之後位置，走第二疊。直路彎略為追近。跑過五百五十米處後開始上前。直路上對催策反應甚佳。一百五十米處取得領先，保持佳勢至終點，掄元。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow(-) (2W2W) Taken back from wide draw and settled rearward, last at 500M, held up for clear running 400M to 250M then finished off well to take 3rd.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速(-)(2W2W) 自外檔出閘，留居後列。五百米處居包尾位置。四百米處至二百五十米處受困而未能望空，其後衝刺良佳，跑獲季軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow(-) (1W1W2W3W) Settled worse than midfield on the rail, held up top of Straight, closed off strongly to score.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速(-)(1W1W2W3W) 居中間之後位置，走內欄。直路初受困。末段衝刺強勁，勝出賽事。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W2W2W3W) Reserved near last 8Ls off the pace, had the task in hand 400M, brought wide into straight, came from a long way back and made solid inroads to finish 5th.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W2W2W3W) 留居接近包尾位置，落後領放馬八個馬位。四百米處仍落後頗遠。入直路時移出外疊，自遙遙落後的位置上前。末段追前甚多，取得第五名。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W4W) Settled towards the rear 9-10Ls off the pace in early and middle stages, couldn't go on passing 400M, no extra mid-straight and weakened rapidly. (No Vet findings.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W4W) 居後列，早段及中段落後領放馬九至十個馬位。跑過四百米處時無以為繼。直路中段再無餘力，迅速轉弱。（賽後接受獸醫檢查，並無發現任何明顯異常之處。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W3W) Began slowly losing ground, gradually recovered to just behind midfield on rail, crowded between runners entering home straight, kept on steadily under pressure without quickening inside final 300M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W3W) 出閘緩慢，失地。逐漸恢復走勢，居中間稍後位置，走內欄。入直路時在馬匹之間受擠迫。最後三百米在催策下保持穩勢，但未能加速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W5W) Sat midfield 2 wide, angled out near 550M, kept on well early in the straight, ran on evenly. (See incident report.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W5W) 居中間位置，走第二疊。接近五百五十米處時向外移出。直路早段保持佳勢，末段走勢平穩。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W4W) From wide draw taken back and reserved near last, over 10Ls off leader middle stages, driven 450M and ran to the line well without troubling first few. Pleasing return after long absence.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W4W) 自外檔出閘後留居接近包尾位置。中段落後領放馬逾十個馬位。四百五十米處受催策。末段衝刺良佳，但未能威脅首數名馬匹。久休復出，表現令人滿意。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow(-) (1W4W) On jumping was checked, settled towards the rear in a slowly run race, had big task in hand 450M, closed off the race well to claim 4th near line but couldn't quite crack the top-three.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速(-)(1W4W) 躍出時勒避，居後列，賽事步速緩慢。四百五十米處落後頗遠。衝刺良佳，接近終點時取得第四名，但不足以挑戰三甲馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (2W2W2W4W) Settled in front of midfield 2 wide, made some late headway.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(2W2W2W4W) 居中間之前位置，走第二疊。末段略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W1W1W) From draw 12 shifted behind runners, settled at the back of the field 8-9Ls off pace in the first half of the race, ran on only fairly through final 300M. (No Vet findings.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W1W1W) 自第十二檔出閘後在馬群之後切入，前半程留居後列，落後領放馬八至九個馬位。最後三百米走勢僅屬一般。（賽後接受獸醫檢查，並無發現任何明顯異常之處。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W4W) From draw 1 moved up to race in 5th, always close enough to leaders, shifted out from fence passing 500M, ran on well final 300M to take 3rd.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W4W) 自第一檔出閘後上前，居第五位，沿途保持落後領先馬匹不遠。跑過五百米處時移離內欄。最後三百米走勢良佳，跑獲季軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow(-) (3W3W) Dropped out from widest draw, still in last place top of home straight, ran on well final 200m, tight for room close home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速(-)(3W3W) 自最外檔出閘後墮後。直路初仍居包尾位置。最後二百米以佳勢上前。接近終點時受緊迫。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow(-) (1W2W2W3W) From draw 1 obtained running in midfield, switched to 2-wide 1100M, driven 400M out, ran on strongly down outside to get up close home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速(-)(1W2W2W3W) 自第一檔出閘後居中間位置。千一米處移至第二疊。四百米處受催策。末段沿外疊以勁勢上前，接近終點時取得領先。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (2W2W2W2W) Waited with in rear, still in rear top of home straight, followed winner through 200m out, ran on well.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(2W2W2W2W) 居後列，留力候上。直路初仍居後列。二百米處跟隨頭馬上前。末段保持佳勢。

raceinfo_chi.RaceName: 中銀香港BOC PAY+ 讓賽

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W) Tracked leader, pressed leader on bend, ridden top of home straight, dropped away quickly final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W) 跟隨領放馬。直路彎追迫領放馬。直路初受催策。最後二百米迅速墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow(+) (1W1W) Clean jump, sent forward to take the lead, led by 3/4L turning in, kept on well in straight but unable to hold off the winner close home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速(+)(1W1W) 出閘俐落，受催策上前領放。入直路時領先四分三個馬位。直路上保持佳勢，但接近終點時未能抗衡頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Box seat, travelled smoothly into home straight, stayed on well but no match for winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 居包廂位置。入直路時走勢暢順。末段保持佳勢，但不敵頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W) Made all, keen under restraint, kicked early in home straight and ran on well, margin reduced closing stages but always doing enough.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W) 一放到底。在約束下搶口。直路早段加速，走勢良佳。末段領先距離收窄，但一直保持佳勢，穩操勝券。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W2W) Jumped awkwardly, obtained a midfield position along the inside, brought wide 300M to find clear running but responded only fairly. (Jockey - didn't travel well during the event and changed stride on a number of occasions.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W2W) 出閘笨拙，居中間位置，走內疊。三百米處移出外疊以望空，但對催策反應僅屬一般。（騎師表示，坐騎沿途走勢欠佳，數度轉腳。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W3W) Moderately away, raced better than midfield on the inside, angled out after passing 600M, 1-3/4L back turning in, kept on evenly in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W3W) 出閘普通，居中間之前位置，走內疊。跑過六百米處後向外移出。入直路時落後一又四分三個馬位。直路上保持穩勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Sat on pace, traveled comfortably, closed off strongly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 居前列。走勢暢順。衝刺強勁。

formguide.comments_eng: Australian PP, a 4-year-old gelding, by Dundeel out of the Redoute’s Choice mare Abbey Marie. Horses by the same sire include Corleone and Silvery Breeze. This fellow had eleven starts for two wins (3yo+ maiden handicap over 1600m and a handicap over 1500m) and three placings (including a 3yo group one over 2400m). He was given two trials in Hong Kong. In the latest trial, he sat last and finished seventh, beaten by 11-1/2Ls, under pressure over 1200m AWT at Sha Tin on November 10. He will probably need a run.
formguide.comments_chi: 「一錘定音」(Dundeel)之後，在港同父馬包括「相映紅」及「銀亮奔騰」等駒，生母出自「利得精選」(Redoute's Choice)。來港前在澳洲十一戰得兩勝三位，頭馬包括一場1600米三歲及以上從未勝出馬讓磅賽，及一場1500米讓賽，上名賽事包括一場2400米三歲一級賽。抵港後試閘兩次。最近11月10日出試田泥1200米，早段居包尾位置，末段力策下跑第七名，落後頭馬11.5個馬位。首戰熱身為主。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (3W4W) Bumped exiting stalls, mid division, wide into home straight, ran on strongly final 300m to challenge leaders, just failed.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(3W4W) 出閘時發生碰撞，居中間位置。入直路時走外疊。最後三百米以勁勢上前挑戰領先馬匹。僅敗。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W2W) Began well from gate 1, raced in midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, no clear run early in straight, cleared 300M, finished off very strongly to score.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W2W) 自第一檔出閘迅速，居中間位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路初未能望空。三百米處望空。末段衝刺凌厲，勝出賽事。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (3W3W) From wide draw dropped back to race at the rear further back than intended, 9Ls off the pace middle stages, still some work to do top of the straight, closed off fastest to lead inside 150M. Won convincingly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(3W3W) 自外檔出閘，留居較賽前部署為後的後列位置。中段落後領放馬九個馬位。直路初仍落後頗遠。衝刺最快，一百五十米處取得領先。從容勝出。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W) Tracked leaders against rail, well placed into home straight and followed winner through 350m out, stayed on well but always held.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W) 跟隨領先馬匹，走內欄。入直路時居好位。三百五十米處跟隨頭馬上前。保持佳勢，但一直落後。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W3W) Raced in touch with leaders, wide on bend, improved to lead over 200m out, tended to edge left in front, headed late on.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W3W) 居領先馬匹之後的啣接位置。直路彎走外疊。推進上前，二百米處取得領先。在居前競跑下傾向外閃。末段被超越。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Sat midfield 2 wide, stayed on nicely.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 居中間位置，走第二疊。末段保持佳勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W4W) Wide throughout, made contact with rival when improving into contention on bend, weakened 200m out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W4W) 沿途走外疊。直路彎在上前爭勝之際與對手互相觸碰。二百米處轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W3W) Settled in mid-field, forced to steady 900m out, ridden top of home straight, lacked pace to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W3W) 居中間位置。九百米處被迫收慢。直路初受催策，但速度不足以展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W) Waited with in rear, short of room early in home straight, unable to pick up for pressure from 250m out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W) 居後列，留力候上。直路初空位不足。自二百五十米處起在催策下未能加速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (3W5W) Bumped out of stalls, three wide in mid-field without cover, driven along 500m out, lost touch final 300m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(3W5W) 出閘時與對手互相碰撞，居中間位置，走第三疊，沒有遮擋。五百米處受催策。最後三百米被拋離。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (5W5W) Raced in rear after slowly away, pushed along very wide into home straight, good headway early in home straight, no extra close home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(5W5W) 出閘緩慢，居後列。入直路時受推策，走大外疊。直路上追前頗多，接近終點時再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W3W) Jumped awkwardly and lost ground, raced at tail, 8 to 9 lengths back in the middle stages, made some headway in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W3W) 出閘笨拙及失地，居包尾位置。中段落後八至九個馬位。直路上略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (1W1W) Raced in rear, unable to secure clear run until 200m out, ran on strongly to close on winner but always held.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(1W1W) 居後列。未能望空直至二百米處。末段以勁勢上前，追近頭馬，但一直落後。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Jumped only fairly, settle 3Ls off leaders, couldn't quicken to challenge leaders final 300M. Never likely.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;出閘僅屬一般，落後領先馬匹三個馬位。最後三百米未能加速挑戰領先馬匹。從未看似有力爭勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good; Stayed within striking distance from leaders, briefly held up 250M but lacked a strong response in the final stages.
(Blood in trachea.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等步速;保持落後領先馬匹不遠。二百五十米處一度受困，但末段對催策反應欠強勁。
（氣管有血。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Bumped shortly after start, raced in midfield on the inside, hung out and made contact near 900M, moved a bit closer along the rail on turn, kept on well in straight to take a place, not quite able to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 起步後不久發生碰撞，居中間位置，走內疊。接近九百米處時外閃及發生觸踫。直路彎沿欄略為追近。直路上保持佳勢，跑獲季軍，但未能展開真正挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W) Well there, restrained to 3rd passing the 900M, did not find much room behind runners over 150M out, fought on well late to grab 2nd final strides.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W) 居好位，跑過九百米處時受約束，居第三位。一百五十米處在馬匹之後空位不足。末段以佳勢力拼，最後數步取得亞軍。

formguide.comments_eng: British PP, a 3-year-old gelding, by Lope Y Fernandez	out of the Lucky Story mare Royal Rascal. He will be the first runner of his sire in Hong Kong.
