This fellow had seven starts for two wins (two 3yo handicaps over 1487m) and three placings. He was given four trials for two placings in Hong Kong. He raced handily and finished third, beaten by 1-1/4Ls, under pressure over 1600m on turf in Conghua on October 23. In the latest trial, he sat midfield and finished sixth, beaten by 4-1/2Ls, under pressure over 1200m AWT at Sha Tin on November 10. He will probably need a run.
formguide.comments_chi: 「文壇怪傑」(Lope Y Fernandez)之後，是此父系首匹在港上陣馬，生母出自「幸運故事」(Lucky Story)。來港前在英國七戰得兩勝三位，頭馬為兩場1487米三歲馬讓磅賽。抵港後四次試閘兩次上名。10月23日出試從化草地1600米，早段居前競跑，末段力策下跑第三名，落後頭馬1.25個馬位。最近11月10日出試田泥1200米，早段居中，末段力策下跑第六名，落後頭馬4.5個馬位。首戰熱身為主。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (1W1W) Dropped out from wide draw, held up last, still in last place top of home straight, ran on well final 200m to pass plenty of field.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(1W1W) 自外檔出閘後墮後，留居包尾位置。直路初仍居包尾位置。最後二百米以佳勢上前，超越多駒。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W1W1W1W) Broke well before restraining one-back in 4th or 3rd on rail, came under pressure 2L back home bend, hung in upon straightening and made no further impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W1W1W1W) 出閘迅速，其後受約束居第三或第四位，落後領放馬一個馬位，走內欄。直路彎受催策，落後兩個馬位。入直路時內閃，其後再無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W2W) Made contact at start, taken back to race at rear on the outside, 5Ls back turning in, made some headway in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W2W) 起步時發生觸碰，留居後列，走外疊。入直路時落後五個馬位。直路上略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Raced in rear, still in rear into home straight, unable to improve position.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 居後列。入直路時仍居後列。未能推進。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W) Three wide in mid-field, driven along 600m out, outpaced and left behind final 250m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W) 居中間位置，走第三疊。六百米處受催策。最後二百五十米未能跟上步速，被拋離。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W1W) Shifted in and heavily bumped out of stalls, waited with towards rear, under pressure 700m out, made up some late ground.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W1W) 出閘時向內斜跑，發生大力碰撞。居後列，留力候上。七百米處受催策，末段略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Sat at the rear, picked off a few weakened rivals.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;居後列。其後超越數匹已轉弱的對手。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (4W3W) Crowded start, raced better than midfield on the outside, no cover throughout, 2 lengths back turning in, peaked early in straight, weakened final furlong.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(4W3W) 起步時受擠迫，居中間之前位置，走外疊，沿途沒有遮擋。入直路時落後兩個馬位。直路早段未能再增速，最後二百米轉弱。

formguide.comments_eng: Australian PP, a 4-year-old gelding, by Farnan out of the Galileo mare Gallant Tess. Horses by the same sire include Speedy Power and Grand Eagle. This fellow had three starts for one placing (a 3yo+ maiden over 1600m). He was given four trials for two wins in Hong Kong. He sat midfield and won by a short-head, under pressure over 1200m on turf in Conghua on October 5. In the latest trial, he sat midfield and won by a nose, under slight pressure over 1200m on turf in Conghua on November 6. He's a nice horse and could run well here on debut.
formguide.comments_chi: 「輝隆」(Farnan)之後，在港同父馬包括「閃電奇駿」及「神鵰」等駒，生母出自「天文學家」(Galileo)。來港前在澳洲三戰一次上名，上名賽事為一場1600米三歲及以上從未勝出馬賽。抵港後四次試閘得兩勝。10月5日出試從化草地1200米，早段居中，末段力策下以短馬頭位之先勝出。最近11月6日出試從化草地1200米，早段居中，末段稍騎下以一鼻位之先勝出。潛質不俗，預計初出會有良好走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W4W) Bumped start, taken back to race towards rear on the outside, 5 lengths or so back turning in, failed to close off in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W4W) 起步時發生碰撞，留居後列，走外疊。入直路時落後約五個馬位。直路上未能以勁勢衝刺。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Raced in rear after crowded at start, driven along 500m out, well held from 400m out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 起步時受擠迫，其後居後列。五百米處受催策。自四百米處起遙遙落後。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W3W) Never far off mainly in 5th, weakened steadily after straightening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W3W) 大多居第五位，從未遠離領先馬匹。入直路後逐漸轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W2W) Settled in second half of the field early stages, moved up to midfield middle stages but ran home only one paced final straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W2W) 早段居後半馬群中。中段上前至中間位置，但直路上僅能保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Slowly away, some headway early in home straight, left behind final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 出閘緩慢。直路早段略為追前。最後二百米被拋離。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (4W2W) Bumped start, raced in 3rd, 2 to 3 lengths back turning in, kept on well in straight to take a place without threatening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(4W2W) 起步時發生碰撞，居第三位。入直路時落後兩至三個馬位。直路上保持佳勢，跑獲季軍，但未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(-) (1W1W) Showed good speed to lead, set strong pace, headed by winner 250m out, sticking to task, just lost third.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(-)(1W1W) 展現甚快前速，取得領先，以快步速領放。二百五十米處被頭馬超越。末段持續力拼，僅失去季席。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Emerged as leader passing 1300M, took them along at good pace middle stages, still going well passing 400M then kept on strongly final stages under big weight to hold pursuing rivals at bay. Won 4 from 4.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 跑過千三米處時取得領先。中段以快步速領放。跑過四百米處時仍保持佳勢。末段在負重磅下保持勁勢，力拒緊追的對手掄元。迄今四戰四勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Showed good speed to lead, keen early stages, three lengths clear 800m out, margin reduced turning into home straight, quickened early in home straight and soon in command.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 展現甚快前速，領放。早段搶口。八百米處帶離三個馬位。轉入直路時領先距離收窄。直路初加速，瞬即控制大局。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W) Jumped well, sent forward to take the lead, travelled well to turn, kept on strongly in straight, won comfortably.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W) 出閘迅速，受催策上前領放。直路彎前走勢良佳。直路上保持勁勢。輕鬆勝出。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Bumped on jumping, sent forward to race prominently, took the lead near 900M, led by a length turning in, kept on very well in straight, easily scored.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 躍出時被碰撞，受催策上前，居前列。接近九百米處時取得領先。入直路時領先一個馬位。直路上保持甚佳走勢，輕鬆勝出。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W1W3W) Rail position in mid-field, challenged and every chance from 400m out, ran on well and beaten only narrowly, checked on line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W1W3W) 居中間位置，走內欄。自四百米處起展開挑戰，一度甚具爭勝機會。末段以佳勢上前，僅以短距離之差落敗。過終點時勒避。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Crowded and bumped at start, settled in mid-field, short of room 300m out, stayed on but lacked pace to reach leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 起步時受擠迫及發生碰撞，居中間位置。三百米處空位不足。保持走勢，但速度不足以追上領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W3W) Began well, raced towards rear on the outside, 5 lengths back turning in, made no progress in straight. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W3W) 出閘迅速，居後列，走外疊。入直路時落後五個馬位。直路上毫無進展。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W1W1W1W) Broke well from the one draw settling in forward of midfield mainly in 5th just under 6L off the pace, gained closer to just over 2L off the lead 200M out, soon found no extra.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W1W1W1W) 自第一檔出閘迅速，居中間之前位置，大多居第五位，落後領放馬近六個馬位。其後追近，二百米處落後領放馬稍逾兩個馬位。瞬即再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good; (1W2W) Last to jump, sat midfield on the rail, slightly held up early part of the Straight, ran on strongly, always held.
(Jockey dropped right rein between the 200 Metres and the 100 Metres.)
runnerrecords.incident_eng: (Jockey dropped right rein between the 200 Metres and the 100 Metres.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等步速;(1W2W) 出閘最慢，居中間位置，走內欄。直路初略為受困。以勁勢上前，但一直落後頭馬。
（騎師於二百米處至一百米處之間右邊韁繩脫手。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W1W) Jumped awkwardly and lost ground, held up in midfield along the inside, came with a serious challenge passing 300M but was crowded 100M losing momentum. Could have finished closer.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W1W) 出閘笨拙及失地，留居中間位置，走內疊。跑過三百米處時展開真正挑戰，但一百米處受擠迫，失去步韻。本可跑入更前位置。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W4W) Settled towards rear, commenced move 3-wide rounding home bend, tightened and forced to switch inside 400M out, inconvenienced again just inside the 200M, finished off the race well.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W4W) 居後列。轉直路彎時開始上前，走第三疊。四百米處受緊迫，被迫移向內疊。跑過二百米處後再度受妨礙。末段以佳勢衝刺。

formguide.comments_eng: Australian PP, a 4-year-old gelding, by Wootton Bassett out of the Fastnet Rock mare Southbank. Horses by the same sire include Stunning Peach and Viva Chaleur. This fellow had fifteen starts for two wins (including a 3yo group one over 2400m) and five placings (including a 3yo group two over 2040m and two 3yo group threes over 2000m). He was given three trials for two placings in Hong Kong. He raced handily and finished third, beaten by 4-1/4Ls, under slight pressure over 1000m on turf at Sha Tin on October 13. In the latest trial, he sat midfield and finished third, beaten by a short-head, under a hold over 1200m AWT in Conghua on November 12. He looks an interesting debutant and could run well here.
formguide.comments_chi: 「活頓鎮」(Wootton Bassett)之後，在港同父馬包括「桃花開」及「爆熱」等駒，生母出自「燈塔島」(Fastnet Rock)。來港前在澳洲十五戰得兩勝五位，頭馬包括一場2400米三歲一級賽，上名賽事包括一場2040米三歲二級賽，及兩場2000米三歲三級賽。抵港後三次試閘兩次上名。10月13日出試田草1000米，早段居前競跑，末段稍騎下跑第三名，落後頭馬4.25個馬位。最近11月12日出試從化泥地1200米，早段居中，末段按韁下跑第三名，落後頭馬短馬頭位。初出應可交出良好表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W2W) Sluggish start, rail position in mid-field, switched wide for clear run into home straight, ran on well final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W2W) 起步緩慢，居中間位置，走內欄。入直路時移出外疊以望空。最後二百米走勢良佳。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Crowded shortly after start, rail position in mid-field, pushed along on bend to maintain position, unable to improve position.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 起步後不久受擠迫，居中間位置，走內欄。直路彎受推策以保持位置。末段未能推進上前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (3W5W) Made contact at start, raced slightly behind midfield on the outside, 5 lengths back turning in, kept on same pace in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(3W5W) 起步時發生觸碰，居中間稍後位置，走外疊。入直路時落後五個馬位。直路上保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W1W) Commenced well, raced better than midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, took the lead 200M, kept on well to the line and scored.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W1W) 出閘迅速，居中間之前位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。二百米處取得領先，保持佳勢至終點，勝出賽事。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow(-) (2W3W) Began only fairly and made contact, raced 2 wide behind midfield, 3 wide turning in, finished off strongly to take 2nd, just beaten by a head.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速(-)(2W3W) 出閘僅屬一般，與對手互相觸碰，居中間之後位置，走第二疊。入直路時走第三疊，衝刺強勁，取得亞軍，僅以一馬頭位之差見負。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (1W1W) Taken back from gate 9, raced at rear on the inside, saved ground on turn, no clear run early in straight, cleared near 250M, closed off well to take a place without threatening the first two.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(1W1W) 自第九檔出閘後留居包尾位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路早段未能望空。接近二百五十米處時望空。末段以佳勢衝刺，跑入季席，但未能威脅首兩名馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow(-) (3W3W) Slightly slow out and crowded, raced 3 wide with cover behind midfield, 4 lengths or so back, same margin back on turn, made good progress in straight to take a place. (See Racing Incidents.)

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W3W) Bumped leaving stalls, settled in rear of mid-field, pushed along wide into home straight, lost touch final 250m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W3W) 出閘時發生碰撞，居中間之後位置。入直路時受推策，走外疊。最後二百五十米被拋離。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Crowded and bumped at start, outpaced in rear, ridden along top of home straight, soon well held.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 起步時受擠迫，被碰撞。未能跟上步速，居後列。直路初受催策，瞬即遙遙落後。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W) Shifted out at start and made contact, raced slightly behind midfield on the outside, kept on same pace in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W) 起步時向外斜跑，與對手互相觸碰。居中間稍後位置，走外疊。直路上保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W1W) Shifted out and bumped out of stalls, rail position in mid-field, struggled to hold position from 500m out, no impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W1W) 出閘時向外斜跑，發生碰撞，居中間位置，走內欄。自五百米處起難以保持位置。毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W3W) Raced wide, shuffled back mid-race, pushed along widest into home straight, did not have speed to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W3W) 走外疊。中段墮後。入直路時受推策，走最外疊。未能增速以展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (3W3W3W4W) Prominent early settling 3-wide in midfield, gave ground quickly from 600M out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(3W3W3W4W) 早段居前列，其後居中間位置，走第三疊。自六百米處起迅速墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Raced in touch with leaders, ridden top of home straight, strong run to lead 200m out, on top from there.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 跟隨領先馬匹。直路初受催策。走勢強勁，二百米處取得領先，其後保持領先至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (1W1W2W) From wide draw shifted across behind runners after the start, settled in second half of the field 6-7Ls off the pace, picked up impressively from 400M and got past leader close home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(1W1W2W) 自外檔起步後在馬群之後切入，居後半馬群中，落後領放馬六至七個馬位。自四百米處起加速強勁。接近終點時超越領放馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (3W2W2W) Settled in midfield, came under pressure from approaching home turn 400M out, tight between runners 100M out, ran on closing stages to just fail to get up on line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(3W2W2W) 居中間位置，自四百米處趨近直路彎時受催策。一百米處在馬匹之間受緊迫。末段追前，過終點時僅敗。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (1W1W3W) Checked shortly after start, held up last, pushed along widest into home straight, hung in 300m out, ran on strongly final 100m, just failed.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(1W1W3W) 起步後不久勒避，留居包尾位置。入直路時受推策，走最外疊。三百米處內閃。最後一百米以勁勢追前。僅敗。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (1W1W1W) Bumped out of stalls, raced in touch with leaders, had to wait for run turning into home straight, strong run to lead 150m out, won cosily.

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Away well, raced better than midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, no daylight early in straight, cleared 300M, kept on well until approaching 50M, weakened gradually close home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 出閘迅速，居中間之前位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路初未能望空，三百米處望空。保持佳勢直至趨近五十米處，接近終點時逐漸轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Tracked leaders against rail, tended to hang right in home straight, one paced under pressure.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 跟隨領先馬匹，走內欄。直路上傾向內閃。在催策下保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W1W) Soon took up running holding narrow advantage, went some 1L clear upon straightening and hung on to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W1W) 瞬即領放，以短距離領先。入直路時帶離約一個馬位，保持走勢至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(-) (2W4W) Tracked leaders, taken wider on bend, ridden along 350m out and stayed on well, closed on winner late on but always held.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(-)(2W4W) 跟隨領先馬匹。直路彎移出較外疊。三百五十米處受催策，保持佳勢。末段追近頭馬，但一直落後該駒。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W) Began well from gate 1, raced better than midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, kept to inside after straightening and finished off strongly, led close home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W) 自第一檔出閘迅速，居中間之前位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。入直路後保持走內疊。末段衝刺強勁，接近終點時取得領先。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Jumped well, raced 2 wide, a length or so back, there to turn, kept on well until approaching 100M, weakened gradually final 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 出閘迅速，走第二疊，落後約一個馬位。直路彎前居相同位置。保持佳勢直至趨近一百米處時。最後一百米逐漸轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W1W) Made contact at start, sent forward to take the lead, led by 1/2L turning in, peaked and headed approaching 200M, weakened final 150M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W1W) 起步時發生觸碰，其後受催策上前領放。入直路時領先半個馬位。趨近二百米處時未能再增速及被超越。最後一百五十米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W) Raced in touch with leaders, had to wait for run on bend, short of room from 300m out to 100m out, unlucky.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W) 跟隨領先馬匹。直路彎須等待空位出現。自三百米處起至一百米處空位不足。跑來欠運。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (4W3W) Tracked pace out wide, ridden early in home straight, bumped 350m out, stayed on steadily for a clear third but no threat to leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(4W3W) 跟隨領放馬，走外疊。直路早段受催策。三百五十米處與對手互相碰撞。保持穩勢，在帶離餘駒下跑獲季軍，但未能威脅領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W3W) Settled in mid-field, keen 1000m out, ridden top of home straight, crowded and briefly hampered 125m out, unable to recover.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W3W) 居中間位置。一千米處搶口。直路初受催策。一百二十五米處受擠迫及一度受阻礙。其後未能恢復走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W4W) Tracked pace out wide without cover, wide into home straight, stayed on steadily but unable to match front two.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W4W) 跟隨領放馬，走外疊，沒有遮擋。入直路時走外疊。保持穩勢，但未能追及首兩名馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (2W2W) Settled in mid-field, challenged and every chance from top of home straight, ran on strongly final 200m, just failed.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(2W2W) 居中間位置。自直路初起展開挑戰，一度甚具爭勝機會。最後二百米以勁勢追前。僅敗。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W4W) Four wide in rear of mid-field without cover, ridden along 400m out, stayed on but unable to reach leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W4W) 居中間之後位置，走第四疊，沒有遮擋。四百米處受催策。末段保持走勢，但未能追上領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (4W4W) Crowded at start, raced very wide in rear, under pressure 600m out, ran on well to close on leaders.

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (3W4W) Bumped on jumping, raced 3 wide with cover behind midfield, 4 lengths or so back turning in, closed off well to take a place.

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good to slow(-) (2W4W) On the back foot after badly squeezed shortly after the start, niggled throughout to stay attached, took a while to get into stride over final stages and won impressively from last.
(Blood in trachea.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等偏慢步速(-)(2W4W) 起步後不久嚴重受擠迫，居包尾位置。沿途在催策下跟隨馬群。末段加速需時，自包尾位置取勝，姿態出色。
（氣管有血。）

runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W2W) 自第一檔出閘迅速，落後領放馬一個半馬位，走內疊。直路彎前走勢輕鬆。直路上對催策反應良佳。一百五十米處取得領先。保持甚佳走勢至終點，勝出賽事。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W) Showed good speed to lead, pressed on 400m out, ran on well and in control final 150m, margin reduced closing stages but always doing enough.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W) 展現甚快前速以領放。四百米處受追迫。保持佳勢，最後一百五十米控制大局。末段領先距離收窄，但足以取勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W5W) Tracked pace out wide without cover, keen middle stages, taken wider into home straight, stayed on but lacked pace to reach leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W5W) 跟隨領放馬，走外疊，沒有遮擋。中段搶口。入直路時被帶出較外疊。保持走勢，但速度不足以追及領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W) Chased the leader, traveled nicely, made good ground inside 200M to score.

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W2W) Pressed leader, ridden and challenged leader top of home straight, stayed on well but no match for winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W2W) 追迫領放馬。直路初在催策下挑戰領放馬。保持佳勢，但不敵頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W) Tracked leaders against rail, well placed into home straight, one paced under pressure.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W) 跟隨領先馬匹，走內欄。入直路時居好位。末段在催策下保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Jumped on terms and tracked leaders, raced keenly middle stages, close enough turning home but could only keep on at the same speed final 400M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 與對手同步出閘，跟隨領先馬匹。中段搶口。轉入直路時落後不遠，但最後四百米僅能保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W2W) Tracked leaders against rail, challenged and every chance from 400m out, ran on well to lead 250m out, headed by winner 100m out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W2W) 跟隨領先馬匹，走內欄。自四百米處起展開挑戰，一度甚具爭勝機會。以佳勢上前，二百五十米處取得領先。一百米處被頭馬超越。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Waited with in rear, pushed along and headway from 300m out, chased down leader final 150m, led close home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 居後列，留力候上。自三百米處起受推策，上前。最後一百五十米追上領放馬。接近終點時取得領先。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W1W) Average to begin, positioned a length behind the leader on the inside, saved ground on turn, no clear run early in straight, cleared 200M, finished off strongly to score.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W1W) 出閘普通，落後領放馬一個馬位，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路初未能望空。二百米處望空。末段衝刺強勁，掄元。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W2W) Dropped out from wide draw, still in rear top of home straight, switched for clear run 300m out, unable to get on terms with leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W2W) 自外檔出閘後墮後。直路初仍居後列。三百米處轉換跑線以望空。末段未能追上領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W2W) Rail position in rear of mid-field, angled off rail 500m out, lacked pace to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W2W) 居中間之後位置，走內欄。五百米處移離內欄。未能增速以展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W1W) Dropped out from wide draw, some headway on bend, sustained headway in home straight but always held.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W1W) 自外檔出閘後墮後。直路彎略為追前。直路上持續上前，但一直落後。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W1W2W3W) Settled well back on the fence, moved off the rail in the middle stages, closed off fairly over the final stages.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W1W2W3W) 遙居於後，走內欄。中段移離內欄。末段衝刺一般。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W1W) Began awkwardly and made contact shortly after start, raced 2 wide at rear, found rail 900M, saved ground on turn, kept on well early in straight, peaked 150M, weakened gradually thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W1W) 出閘笨拙，其後不久發生觸碰，居後列，走第二疊。九百米處移入內欄，直路彎走內欄節省腳程。直路初保持佳勢。一百五十米處時未能再增速，其後逐漸轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Rail position in mid-field, travelled smoothly into home straight, one paced under pressure.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 居中間位置，走內欄。入直路時走勢暢順。末段在催策下保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W4W) Three wide in rear, pushed along wide into home straight, unable to quicken.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W4W) 居後列，走第三疊。入直路時受推策，走外疊。未能加速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W) Raced in touch with leaders, travelled smoothly into home straight, unable to secure clear run until 200m out, unable to recover.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W) 跟隨領先馬匹。入直路時走勢暢順。未能望空直至二百米處。末段未能恢復走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W4W) Raced very wide throughout without cover in mid division, strong run in home straight to lead 200m out, won cosily.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W4W) 居中間位置，沿途走大外疊，沒有遮擋。直路上走勢強勁，二百米處領先，從容取勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W3W) Began only fairly, raced 2 wide slightly behind midfield, wider turning in, finished off strongly to take 2nd, nearest on line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W3W) 出閘僅屬一般，居中間稍後位置，走第二疊。入直路時走較外疊。末段衝刺強勁，跑獲亞軍，過終點時最為接近。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Bumped out of stalls, rail position in mid-field, struggled to hold position mid-race, bumped 300m out, eased when detached 200m out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 出閘時與對手互相碰撞，居中間位置，走內欄。中段難以保持位置。三百米處與對手互相碰撞。二百米處被?離之際收慢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; Made contact shortly after start, positioned 2 to 3 lengths behind the leader in the middle of the track, finished off well to take 2nd without threatening the winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;起步後不久與對手互相觸碰，落後領放馬兩至三個馬位，在跑道中央競跑。末段衝刺良佳，跑入亞席，但未能威脅頭馬。

formguide.comments_eng: Irish PP, a 3-year-old gelding, by Starman out of the Motivator mare Ribble. He will be the first runner of this sire in Hong Kong. This fellow had three starts for two wins (a 2yo novice over 1433m on Tapeta, and a 3-5yo novice over 1400m on Polytrack) in Britain. He was given four trials in Hong Kong. In the latest trial, he sat midfield and finished fifth, beaten by 3Ls, under pressure over 1200m on turf in Conghua on November 6. He’s probably not looking like a first-up winner but this race will give us a chance to look at him more closely.
formguide.comments_chi: 「星光俠」(Starman)之後，是此父系首匹在港上陣馬，生母出自「發動力」(Motivator)。來港前在英國三戰得兩勝，頭馬包括一場1433米膠沙地兩歲曾勝出0-2場賽，及一場1400米膠沙地三至五歲曾勝出0-2場賽。抵港後試閘四次。最近11月6日出試從化草地1200米，早段居中，末段力策下跑第五名，落後頭馬三個馬位。不似能一出即勝，觀望為宜。

formguide.comments_eng: New Zealand PP, a 4-year-old gelding, by Contributer out of the Encosta de Lago mare Lady Of Spain. Horses by the same sire include Fortune Boy and Quick Contribution. This fellow had four starts for one placing (a 3yo group three over 1200m). He was given four trials for two placings in Hong Kong. He raced handily and finished second, beaten by 1-1/4Ls, under pressure over 1000m on turf in Conghua on October 12. In the latest trial, he raced handily and finished third, beaten by 2-1/4Ls, under pressure over 1200m on turf in Conghua on November 2. He will probably need a run.
formguide.comments_chi: 「立功者」(Contributer)之後，在港同父馬包括「火焰閃爍」及「飛躍成就」等駒，生母出自「拿高」(Encosta de Lago)。來港前在紐西蘭四戰一次上名，上名賽事為一場1200米三歲三級賽。抵港後四次試閘兩次上名。10月12日出試從化草地1000米，早段居前競跑，末段力策下跑第二名，落後頭馬1.25個馬位。最近11月2日出試從化草地1200米，早段居前競跑，末段力策下跑第三名，落後頭馬2.25個馬位。首戰熱身為主。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (5W3W3W) From draw 10 unable to get closer than 3-wide, travelled towards the rear in the first half, drifted back to last at 400M and soon out of contention.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(5W3W3W) 自第十檔出閘，走第三疊或更外疊。前半程居後列。四百米處墮居包尾位置，瞬即再無爭勝機會。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W1W) Always well back, saved ground on rail into straight, ran home one-paced.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W1W) 沿途遙居於後。入直路時走內欄節省腳程。末段保持同速。
